chinese: 夜空中一条淡淡的彩色云带。

chinese: 视角转动和物体移动时沿屏幕运动方向的模糊,像相机快门一样:

chinese: 亮光在周围物体上泛起光晕。

english: Curtains of green light in the northern night sky.
chinese: 北方的夜空中垂下的绿色光幕。

english: Ghosts, a halo and a starburst where the sun and the brightest lights shine into the view, as
chinese: 太阳和最亮的光源进入视野时产生的鬼影、光晕和星芒,如同相机镜头:

english: How bright the image is before the tone curve.
chinese: 色调曲线之前的画面亮度。

english: How finely the clouds are drawn, as a share of the screen's resolution: sharper clouds for more time.
chinese: 云的绘制精细度(按屏幕分辨率的比例):更精细的云需要更多性能。

english: How long the shutter stays open, as a share of a frame: longer streaks.
chinese: 快门开启时长(按一帧的比例):时间越长拖影越长。

english: How many of the nearest lamps cast shadows: what stands in a street light's or a lamp's
chinese: 多少盏最近的灯投射阴影:站在路灯或灯光下的物体:

english: How many raindrops, snowflakes and splashes are drawn, against the default. How hard it rains is the game's.
chinese: 雨滴、雪花和飞溅的绘制数量(相对默认)。雨的大小仍由游戏决定。

english: How much darker the sides and undersides are than the tops (1: Minecraft's, 0: none).
chinese: 侧面和底面比顶面暗多少(1:与 Minecraft 相同,0:无差异)。

english: How much the dull colours are strengthened, leaving the strong ones as they are.
chinese: 对灰暗色彩的增强程度,鲜艳的颜色保持不变。

english: How steep the tone curve is: deeper shadows and brighter highlights.
chinese: 色调曲线的陡峭程度:更高的对比带来更深的阴影和更亮的高光。

english: How strong every colour is (1: as lit).
chinese: 所有色彩的强度(1:保持原样)。

english: How wide the lens is open: a stronger blur, and a shallower sharp zone.
chinese: 镜头光圈大小:光圈越大模糊越强、清晰区域越浅。

english: Light bounced off what is on screen, and the shade in corners (screen-space indirect light).
chinese: 屏幕内物体的反射光,以及角落的阴影(屏幕空间间接光)。

english: Light in the air: haze over distance, lamp halos, the flashlight's beam, dust indoors.
chinese: 空气中的光:远方的雾霭、灯光光晕、手电光束、室内的尘埃。

english: Samples along each view ray through the clouds towards the horizon, half as many
chinese: 每条视线穿过云层向地平线的采样次数,头顶方向减半:

english: Seconds the focus takes to settle on a new distance (about two thirds of the way).
chinese: 焦点稳定到新距离所需的秒数(约为三分之二处)。

english: Soft: volumetric clouds. Layered: a thin layer of blocks. Either shades the ground.
chinese: 柔和:体积云。层状:一层薄薄的云块。两者都会给地面投下阴影。

english: Steps along each ray through the air: smoother light for more time.
chinese: 每条光线穿过空气的步数:步数越多光线越平滑,但更耗性能。

english: Street lights and outdoor lamps past the loaded chunks shine as small glowing points at night.
chinese: 已加载区块之外的路灯和户外灯在夜晚呈现为小的发光点。

english: Sun shadows out to 22 squares with one cascade, 64 with two, the end of the fog with three.
chinese: 太阳阴影范围:1 级联 22 格,2 级联 64 格,3 级联覆盖到雾的尽头。

english: Taps along each streak: smoother streaks for more time.
chinese: 每条拖影的采样次数:采样越多拖影越平滑,但更耗性能。

english: Taps in each blurred pixel: a smoother blur for more time.
chinese: 每个模糊像素的采样次数:采样越多模糊越平滑,但更耗性能。

english: Taps per point in the sun's shadow filter: softer, smoother shadow edges for more time.
chinese: 太阳阴影滤波器中每个点的采样次数:采样越多阴影边缘越柔和,但更耗性能。

english: Temporal anti-aliasing: smooth edges, and the dissolves' dither averaged out.
chinese: 时间抗锯齿:平滑边缘,并将溶解过渡的抖动平均化。

english: Texels a side of each face of a lamp's shadow cube: sharper lamp shadows for more
chinese: 灯光阴影立方体每个面的分辨率:更高的分辨率带来更清晰的灯光阴影:

english: Texels a side of each sun cascade: sharper shadows for more video memory and time.
chinese: 每级太阳阴影级联的分辨率:更清晰的阴影需要更多显存和时间。

english: The sun's and the moon's shadows from the near world.
chinese: 近处世界中太阳和月亮的阴影。

english: The sun's shadows past the loaded chunks, out to the fog: the far world's buildings and trees,
chinese: 太阳阴影延伸出已加载区块、直到雾的尽头:远景世界的建筑和树木:

english: The sun's shafts through the volumetric light, cut by what stands in them.
chinese: 太阳光穿过体积光形成的光柱,会被其中的物体遮挡。

english: Wet ground and puddles in the rain.
What lies past the surface under the crosshair blurs, more the nearer that surface is, as a
chinese: 准星所指向表面之后的东西会变模糊,该表面越近模糊越强,如同镜头对焦:

english: What the flashlight's beam falls on casts a shadow (a shadow map of its own).
chinese: 手电筒光束照射到的物体会投射阴影(使用独立阴影贴图)。

english: The full look, warmer and bolder: sunlight in the sun's colour over shade cooled by the sky, lights that
chinese: 完整画质,更温暖更鲜明:阳光洒在天空冷却的阴影上,灯光柔和交融:

english: The full look: sun shadows through up to three cascades, per-pixel lamps with shadows from the
chinese: 完整画质:太阳阴影最多三级级联,逐像素灯光带阴影:

english: combine softly, faces shaded by their direction, a sky that burns orange where the sun sets and glares about the
chinese: 面部按朝向着色,日落处天空燃起橙色并围绕日月产生眩光:

english: sun and moon, a thicker fog in the sky's own colour, clouds that shade the ground, light shafts at their strongest at
chinese: 更浓的天色雾霭,云影投在地面,日落时光束最强:

english: A Java Flight Recorder recording of every thread and our frames (its length above), saved to Zomboid/viewpoint-captures. Start moving first.
chinese: 对所有线程和每帧画面的 JFR 性能记录(时长见上),保存到 Zomboid/viewpoint-captures。请先动起来。

english: At most this many corpses are 3D models, and no more than the posed corpses' pool holds (Cap: posed corpses, below; about 1.2 MiB a corpse). With fewer, the models thin out along the whole cone rather than stopping short of its distance.
chinese: 最多有多少尸体作为 3D 模型,且不超过尸体姿态池上限(见下方"姿态池上限",每具约 1.2 MiB)。数量更少时,模型会沿整个视锥均匀稀疏,而不是在远处截断。

english: Blurs the picture as you turn and as things move.
chinese: 视角转动和物体移动时画面产生模糊。

english: Blurs what lies well behind the surface you look at, as a camera's lens does.
chinese: 注视表面后方远处的物体变模糊,如同相机镜头。

english: Bright lights glow over what is round them.
chinese: 亮光在周围物体上泛起光晕。

english: Every corpse within reach in 3D (no count limit)
chinese: 范围内每具尸体都是 3D(无数量限制)

english: For a strong PC: every corpse in the cone, within the distance above, is a 3D model, however many lie there, in place of Most 3D corpses. The posed corpses' pool still bounds them, about 1.2 MiB a corpse: raise its cap (below) for a big pile.
chinese: 强配置电脑:视锥内、距离内的每具尸体都是 3D 模型,不限数量,取代"最多 3D 尸体"。仍受尸体姿态池约束(每具约 1.2 MiB):调高下方上限可容纳大堆尸体。

english: How far ahead a corpse may be a 3D model: the length of the cone that starts at the player and runs ahead, as wide as the screen. The chance of a corpse being a model falls along it from the player's feet, and over its last squares (Fade band) the models dissolve to the flat pictures. At most 40: the ring of chunks the models are drawn in.
chinese: 尸体成为 3D 模型的最远距离:从玩家开始向前延伸、与屏幕同宽的视锥长度。成为模型的概率从玩家脚下向外递减,在最后几格(淡出带)模型溶解为平面贴图。最远 40:模型绘制所在的区块环。

english: On, a corpse is considered for a 3D model only while it lies in the cone that starts at the player and runs ahead as wide as the screen (with a small margin), and is on screen: any other keeps its picture with nothing done for it each frame, and one posed lately takes its pose back as it comes into the cone. Off, to compare: every corpse within the distance, all round the player.
chinese: 开启时,尸体只有位于玩家前方屏幕宽的视锥内(含少量余量)且在屏幕上时,才作为 3D 模型考虑:其余保持贴图、每帧零开销,进入视锥时恢复姿态。关闭时对比:距离内、玩家四周的每具尸体都参与。

english: The most the posed corpses hold, about 1.2 MiB a corpse: it bounds how many corpses are 3D models. Raised or lowered, it takes effect at once.
chinese: 尸体姿态池容量(每具约 1.2 MiB):它限制 3D 尸体数量。调高调低立即生效。

english: 3D corpses only in the cone ahead
chinese: 3D 尸体仅在正前方视锥内
3D 尸体距离(前方格数,最多 40)

english: Characters animated every frame, the nearest
chinese: 每帧都播放动画的角色(最近的)

english: Zombies drawn in each new pose without a fresh snapshot
chinese: 僵尸每次新姿势直接绘制,不重取快照

english: Zombies without a target updated less often from 12 squares
chinese: 12 格外无目标的僵尸更新频率降低

english: Characters seen lately found at once (line of sight)
chinese: 最近看见的角色即时定位(视线)

english: Animals' animations loaded with the game
chinese: 随游戏加载动物的动画

english: Frees about 16 MB of video memory, and as much of the system's commit, a chunk the isometric view has drawn; that view draws them again when it comes back.
chinese: 释放约 16 MB 显存及等量的系统提交内存(等距视角已绘制的区块);回到等距视角时会重新绘制。

english: Isometric chunk textures let go in first person
chinese: 第一人称下释放等距区块贴图

english: The game's light check 10 times a second
chinese: 游戏光照检测每秒 10 次

english: Light switches' power asked 4 times a second
chinese: 灯光开关供电每秒查询 4 次

english: Measuring only: in first person, the game's whole light check at most every 0.1 s. Switches flipped and shots' flashes reach the lamps (and the zombies' sight) up to that late.
chinese: 仅测量:第一人称下整个光照检测最多每 0.1 秒一次。开关切换和枪口闪光到达灯光(和僵尸视线)最多延迟这么久。

english: In first person, the game's light check asks each lamp's switch whether power reaches it every frame; with the grid off that searches round every lamp. Kept for a quarter of a second, power turning on or off reaches the lamps that much later.
chinese: 第一人称下,游戏光照检测每帧查询每盏灯的开关是否有电;电网关闭时这会绕每盏灯搜索。保留四分之一秒,电源开关状态到达灯光会延迟这么久。

english: You stand where the free camera is, on the first floor at or below it; with none loaded there, on the ground.
chinese: 你站在自由相机所在处,位于其所在层或之下的第一层;若那里没有加载任何楼层,则站在地面。

english: How fast the body walks facing the view off forward (backwards with Turn to move, any way but forwards with Strafe), as a share of walking forwards: its steps play faster to keep pace. Never slower than the game's own strafe; aiming keeps the game's.
chinese: 身体面朝视角偏离正前方时的行走速度(转向移动时为后退,侧移时为除向前外的任何方向),以向前行走的比例表示:脚步会加快以跟上节奏。不会慢于游戏自身的侧移;瞄准时保持游戏原值。

english: How long the body takes to turn to where it should face: 0 turns it at once. Aiming always turns it at once.
chinese: 身体转向应朝方向所需时间:0 表示立即转向。瞄准时总是立即转向。

english: How long the walking direction takes to follow the keys, sweeping between them as a controller's stick does: 0 jumps at once. Turning back the other way is always at once.
chinese: 行走方向跟随按键所需时间,像手柄摇杆一样在方向间平滑过渡:0 表示立即切换。转身反向总是立即。

english: How much the view moves with the head as you stand, walk and turn: 0 keeps it steady (the height still follows a crouch), 1 follows the head's every step and sway.
chinese: 站立、行走和转身时画面跟随头部晃动的程度:0 保持稳定(高度仍随下蹲变化),1 跟随头部的每一步和摇摆。

english: How far the view turns for a move of the mouse: 1 is the mod's own speed.
chinese: 鼠标移动对应的视角转动幅度:1 是本 mod 自带的速度。

english: Moving the mouse forward looks down, and back looks up.
chinese: 鼠标向前移动时向下看,向后移动时向上看。

english: Seated in first person, how far the view is moved up (or down) from your head. Sitting in a vehicle sets it to the height saved for that kind of vehicle, or to 0.
chinese: 第一人称坐姿下,视角从头部上移(或下移)的距离。坐进车辆时设为该车型保存的高度,否则为 0。

english: Viewpoint's seated eye: scene units up from the head, by vehicle script (Debug, Seated eye)
chinese: Viewpoint 坐姿视角:按车辆脚本从头部上移的场景单位(调试,坐姿视角)

english: Keeps the height above for the kind of vehicle you sit in: you sit at it whenever you get into one again.
chinese: 为你所坐的车型保存上方高度:下次坐进同型车时自动应用。

english: Middle mouse button: toggle between controlling the cursor/camera
chinese: 鼠标中键:在控制光标/相机之间切换

english: Modern draws the Vivid look: sun, lamp and flashlight shadows, clouds, light in the air, bloom and the effects below. Vanilla is a plain look close to the game's own, light on any graphics card.
chinese: 现代画质呈现 Vivid 效果:太阳、灯光和手电阴影,云,空气中的光,泛光及下方各项特效。原版画质接近游戏原生风格,任何显卡都能轻松运行。

english: Sun, moon, lamp and flashlight shadows: how sharp, how far, and how many lamps cast them.
chinese: 太阳、月亮、灯光和手电的阴影:清晰度、距离以及投射阴影的灯数。

english: The dead bodies within 40 squares as the game's own 3D models rather than flat pictures, as many as the level allows, with about a megabyte of memory for each. Ultra sets no count, and makes models of the bodies all round you, not only of those ahead.
chinese: 40 格内的尸体用游戏原生 3D 模型呈现而非平面贴图,数量随画质档位而定,每具约占 1 MB 内存。超高档不限数量,且四周的尸体都建模,不只是前方的。

english: How far past the loaded area the world is drawn, as simpler buildings, boxes and trees out to the fog. The costliest setting for the processor and memory.
chinese: 已加载区域之外世界绘制的距离:简化的建筑、盒子和树一直延伸到雾中。这是对 CPU 和内存最贵的设置。

english: How many of the distant trees are drawn, and how far out they reach before they fade.
chinese: 远处树木的绘制数量,以及它们延伸到多远才淡出。

english: How much of the distant world is drawn as real buildings rather than boxes, and how fine its ground is. More detail fills more video memory.
chinese: 远处世界有多少按真实建筑绘制而非盒子,以及地面精细度。细节越多占用显存越多。

english: How sharp the baked floors and ground are, and how far round you the sharp ones reach.
chinese: 烘焙地板和地面的清晰度,以及清晰的区域延伸到多远。

english: Smooths jagged edges and shimmer by blending each frame with the last.
chinese: 通过相邻帧混合平滑锯齿边缘和闪烁。

english: Glare, a halo and ghosts where the sun or a bright light shines into the view.
chinese: 太阳或强光进入视野时产生眩光、光晕和鬼影。

english: The built-in packs, and those in Zomboid/viewpoint-shaderpacks: Viewpoint's (a folder with a pack.properties) and shader packs made for Minecraft (minecraft-).
chinese: 内置着色器包,以及 Zomboid/viewpoint-shaderpacks 里的:Viewpoint 自制的(带 pack.properties 的文件夹)和为 Minecraft 制作的着色器包(minecraft-)。

english: It cannot be drawn; Viewpoint's default pack draws meanwhile:
chinese: 无法绘制该着色器包;期间由 Viewpoint 默认包绘制:

english: Finds the packs dropped into Zomboid/viewpoint-shaderpacks since the game started.
chinese: 查找游戏启动后放入 Zomboid/viewpoint-shaderpacks 的着色器包。

english: Sets the mode and the settings that trade the world's detail for speed together; changing any of them makes it Custom. The shader pack's options have their own presets.
chinese: 同时设置画质模式和各项以细节换性能的选项;修改任意一项会变为自定义。着色器包的选项有它们自己的预设。

english: The most this pool holds; lowered, it takes full effect after a restart.
chinese: 该内存池的容量上限;调低后重启游戏完全生效。

english: The pack's own presets of its options; changing any of them makes it Custom.
chinese: 着色器包自带的选项预设;修改任意一项会变为自定义。

english: The frame times, how busy each thread and the GPU are, and the renderer's share of each frame, top right: in full, one line, the graph alone, or off.
chinese: 右上角显示帧时间、各线程和 GPU 的忙碌程度以及渲染器的每帧占比:完整、单行、仅图表或关闭。

english: The engine's light around you, with everything it was given, saved to Zomboid/viewpoint-recordings to fit the light model. Look around first: the engine lights only what you see.
chinese: 引擎在你周围的光照(含全部输入参数)保存到 Zomboid/viewpoint-recordings 以拟合光照模型。先环顾四周:引擎只照亮你看到的部分。

english: Compare the far trees with the chunks' (console, once)
chinese: 与区块数据对比远景树木(控制台,一次)

english: How many chunks round you draw the model packs' authored models; further out, the sprites' art. 0 draws none.
chinese: 你周围多少区块内绘制模型包作者的模型;更远处用原版贴图。0 表示不绘制。

english: Trees kept past the full shell (share)
chinese: 完整外壳之外保留的树木(比例)

english: Furniture in buildings across the grid's edge
chinese: 网格边缘建筑内的家具

english: Light shell ground, texels per tile (0: none)
chinese: 轻量外壳地面,每格纹素数(0:无)

english: Full shell ground, texels per tile
chinese: 完整外壳地面,每格纹素数

english: Switch "Shell ground baked" and compare: the G-buffer holds the shell's band, the shadow maps the far shadow map; the ground bake runs in the floors pass.
chinese: 切换"外壳地面已烘焙"对比:G 缓冲保存外壳带,阴影贴图保存远景阴影图;地面烘焙在地板通道中运行。

english: No floor baked in view yet.
chinese: 视野内还没有烘焙的地板。

english: Levels cooking at once, at most
chinese: 同时烘焙的最大层级数

english: Glass opaque far away, hiding the rooms behind it
chinese: 远处玻璃不透明,隐藏其后房间

english: Glass opaque from storeys above or below
chinese: 玻璃从上层或下层看时不透明

english: Light bounced off what is on screen, and shade in corners. Costly.
chinese: 屏幕内物体的反射光与角落阴影。性能开销大。

english: Light in the air: haze, lamp halos, the flashlight's beam and the sun's shafts.
chinese: 空气中的光:雾霭、灯光光晕、手电光束和太阳光柱。

english: Links the shader pack again with the options as they are now: it takes seconds.
chinese: 用当前选项重新链接着色器包:需要几秒。

english: The full look: sun shadows through up to three cascades, per-pixel lamps with shadows from the nearest, a shadowed flashlight, bounce light, volumetric light with god rays, clouds, rain and puddles, glowing far lamps, bloom and TAA.
chinese: 完整画质:太阳阴影最多三级级联,最近灯光逐像素阴影,带阴影的手电筒,反弹光,带体积光束的体积光,云,雨和水洼,发光的远景灯,泛光和 TAA。

english: The plain look, as vanilla Minecraft's: each square's light at its corners, smoothed across every face, with a fixed shade per side; a sky that only changes colour; a soft shadow under each character; glowing far lamps. No shadow maps, clouds, volumetric light, bounce light, bloom or puddles.
chinese: 朴素画质,与原版 Minecraft 相同:每个方块的光在角上、平滑过渡到每个面,每面固定明暗;天空只变色;每个角色脚下有柔和阴影;远景灯发光。没有阴影贴图、云、体积光、反弹光、泛光或水洼。

english: The full look, warmer and bolder: sunlight in the sun's colour over shade cooled by the sky, lights that combine softly, faces shaded by their direction, a sky that burns orange where the sun sets and glares about the sun and moon, a thicker fog in the sky's own colour, clouds that shade the ground, light shafts at their strongest at sunset, soft-edged shadows, bloom as a soft haze, a filmic tone curve with contrast, saturation and vibrance, a lens flare, depth of field and motion blur.
chinese: 完整画质,更温暖更鲜明:阳光暖色铺在天空冷却的阴影上,灯光柔和交融,面部按朝向着色,日落处天空燃起橙色并围绕日月产生眩光,更浓的天色雾霭,云影投在地面,日落时光束最强,柔和阴影边缘,泛光如薄雾,胶片感色调曲线带来对比度、饱和度和鲜艳度,镜头眩光、景深和动态模糊。

english: How finely the clouds are drawn, as a share of the screen's resolution: sharper \n  clouds for more time.
chinese: 云的绘制精细度(按屏幕分辨率的比例):\n  更精细的云需要更多性能。

english: How many raindrops, snowflakes and splashes are drawn, against the default. How hard it \n  rains is the game's.
chinese: 雨滴、雪花和飞溅的绘制数量(相对默认)。雨的大小仍由游戏决定。

english: Samples along each view ray through the clouds towards the horizon, half as many \n  overhead: smoother, finer clouds for more time.
chinese: 每条视线穿过云层向地平线的采样次数,头顶方向减半:采样越多云越平滑细腻,但更耗性能。

english: Blur along the motion on screen as the view turns and as things move, as a camera's shutter would: moving things streak over what is still behind them.
chinese: 视角转动和物体移动时沿屏幕运动方向产生模糊,如相机快门:移动的物体在静止背景上拖出残影。

english: Ghosts, a halo and a starburst where the sun and the brightest lights shine into the view, as a camera's lens makes them.
chinese: 太阳和最亮光源进入视野时产生鬼影、光晕和星芒,如同相机镜头所现。

english: How many of the nearest lamps cast shadows: what stands in a street light's or a lamp's light (people, cars, furniture, fences) darkens what lies behind it. Each is a cube of shadow maps. Lamps standing together (a crossing's) cast as a group, so their shadows do not jump from lamp to lamp as you walk.
chinese: 多少盏最近的灯投射阴影:站在路灯或灯光下的人、车、家具、围栏会在身后投下暗影。每盏是一组立方体阴影贴图。相邻的灯(如路口)作为一组投射,所以你走过时阴影不会在灯之间跳变。

english: Texels a side of each face of a lamp's shadow cube: sharper lamp shadows for more video memory and time.
chinese: 灯光阴影立方体每个面的纹素数:更高的分辨率带来更清晰的灯光阴影,但更耗显存和时间。

english: The sun's shadows past the loaded chunks, out to the fog: the far world's buildings and trees, and the near world's, cast onto each other.
chinese: 太阳阴影延伸出已加载区块、直到雾的尽头:远景世界的建筑和树木与近处世界互相投射阴影。

english: What lies past the surface under the crosshair blurs, more the nearer that surface is, as a lens focuses. Nearer things, your own hands among them, stay sharp.
chinese: 准星所指向表面之后的东西会变模糊,该表面越近模糊越强,如同镜头对焦。更近的物体(包括你自己的手)保持清晰。
手电筒与枪口火光阴影

english: Directions and steps taken round each pixel, as XeGTAO's presets a step down: Medium
chinese: 每个像素周围采样的方向和步数,按 XeGTAO 预设降一档:中。

english: How far the night turns blue and grey as your eyes adapt to the dark, while lamps keep their
chinese: 夜晚随眼睛适应黑暗而转为蓝灰色的程度,灯光保持原有色彩。

english: How far the water has waves, reflections and depth. Loaded: only the area near you.
chinese: 水面波浪、反射和深度的程度。已加载:仅限你附近的区域。

english: How the scene's light becomes the screen's. Filmic: vivid's, with contrast. Neutral: Khronos PBR
chinese: 场景光照如何转为屏幕色彩。Filmic:Vivid 风格,带对比度。Neutral:Khronos PBR 中性。

english: Reflections show the clouds when they reflect the sky above the screen.
chinese: 反射天空时显示屏幕上方天空中的云。

english: Shows rays of sunlight that go past roofs, trees, poles, people and clouds in front of the sun.
chinese: 显示穿过太阳前方的屋顶、树木、电线杆、人物和云的太阳光线。

english: Smooths jagged edges. TAA+: each frame blended with the ones before, the steadiest and
chinese: 平滑锯齿边缘。TAA+:每帧与之前帧混合,最稳定。

english: The clouds above the low ones, as Horizon Forbidden West draws them: cirrus and veils high up,
chinese: 低云之上的高层云,如《地平线:西之绝境》所绘:高处的卷云和云纱。

english: The ground has the relief and the shine of what it is made of: grass and soil rough and
chinese: 地面呈现其材质应有的起伏和光泽:草地和泥土粗糙。

english: The light the lit floors round about bounce onto walls, ceilings and things, and the light
chinese: 周围被照亮的地面将光反射到墙壁、天花板和物体上。

english: The shade in corners, in creases and under things, where less of the light from all round
chinese: 角落、褶皱和物体下方的阴影,那里来自周围的光较少。

english: The walls have the relief and the shine of what they are made of: brick and stone rough
chinese: 墙壁呈现其材质应有的起伏和光泽:砖石粗糙。

english: The waves on rivers and lakes change each moment. Off: one pattern of waves moves across the water.
chinese: 河流和湖泊的波浪实时变化。关闭:水面只有一种移动的波浪图案。

english: Water, puddles and car paint show what is around them. Off: they show only the sky. Medium: from
chinese: 水面、水洼和车漆反射周围环境。关闭:只反射天空。中:从近处开始。

english: Held on foot: the view turns without turning the body, which keeps walking where it went; in first person within an angle (Controls, Camera). Let go, the view turns back.
chinese: 步行时按住:视角转动而身体不转向,角色继续朝原方向行走;第一人称下限于一定角度(操控/相机)。松开后视角转回。

english: While the view is on: frees the cursor to click on things, or locks it to look around again.
chinese: 视角开启时:释放光标以点击物品,或锁定光标以继续环顾四周。

english: In third person: the camera over the other shoulder.
chinese: 第三人称:相机移到另一侧肩膀上方。

english: In third person: the camera turns back behind the character.
chinese: 第三人称:相机转回角色身后。

english: Starts and stops recording the third-person camera's frames, for the offline checks (TESTING.md).
chinese: 开始或停止录制第三人称相机帧,用于离线检查(TESTING.md)。

english: Hold first person for Texture compression
chinese: 纹理压缩下保持第一人称

english: How much the camera moves by itself in third person: the sway of a camera held by hand, the bob of the steps and the lean into turns. Lower it if the motion makes you feel unwell.
chinese: 第三人称下相机自动晃动的程度:手持相机的摇摆、步伐起伏和转弯倾斜。如果晃动让你不适,请调低。

english: Makes one more frame between each two frames the game draws (AMD FSR 3), so the movement on the screen is smoother. Each frame the game draws comes a little later, so the mouse feels a little slower. It is best when the game is at 60 frames a second or more.
chinese: 在游戏绘制的每两帧之间生成一帧(AMD FSR 3),让画面运动更流畅。每帧稍有延迟,鼠标手感会略慢。游戏 60 帧以上时效果最佳。

english: How detailed the distant buildings and ground are.
chinese: 远处建筑和地面的精细程度。

english: How many distant trees are drawn, and how far.
chinese: 远处树木的绘制数量和距离。

english: How sharp the floors and the ground are.
chinese: 地板和地面的清晰程度。

english: Dead bodies near you as 3D models.
chinese: 附近的尸体以 3D 模型呈现。

english: Model pack mods' 3D models near you.
chinese: 你附近的模型包 mod 的 3D 模型。

english: The 3D models that model pack mods give the game's objects (furniture, cars, signs and more), drawn near you in place of the flat pictures. Off, every object is its flat picture again.
chinese: 模型包 mod 为游戏物体(家具、汽车、路牌等)提供的 3D 模型,在你附近替代平面贴图绘制。关闭后所有物体恢复为平面贴图。

english: How fine the game's own art is, which the walls, the objects and the floors are drawn from. Half loads the game's 1x art: a quarter of the texels, far less video memory and system memory, softer up close. The game takes it as it starts: quit and start it again after you change it.
chinese: 游戏自带美术资源(墙壁、物体、地板贴图来源)的精细度。半档加载游戏 1x 贴图:四分之一纹素,大幅节省显存和系统内存,近看更柔和。修改后需重启游戏生效。

english: How sharp the textures are, near you and at a slant.
chinese: 纹理的清晰程度,包括近处和斜视角。

english: How the textures of the floors, the walls and objects and the 3D models are drawn. Sharp keeps each texel crisp near you and smooth far off. Anisotropic keeps the surfaces sharp at a slant. Lanczos is sharper on the graphics card's time. Nearest shows each texel as a hard square. The World page sets each kind apart.
chinese: 地板、墙壁、物体和 3D 模型纹理的绘制方式。Sharp:近处纹素清晰、远处平滑。Anisotropic:斜视角表面保持锐利。Lanczos:更锐利但更耗显卡。Nearest:每个纹素显示为硬方块。世界页可分别设置各类。

english: The game shows your mouse movements sooner.
chinese: 游戏更及时地显示你的鼠标移动。

english: The game shows your mouse movements sooner. The processor does not prepare frames far ahead of the graphics card. When the graphics card is the slowest part, the frame rate can be a little lower.
chinese: 游戏更及时地显示你的鼠标移动。处理器不再提前准备大量帧。当显卡是瓶颈时,帧率可能略降。

english: These are Viewpoint's own keys; the game's are unchanged. Click a key to change it, then press the new one, with Shift, Ctrl or Alt held if you like; Esc keeps it as it was. A mouse button can be a key too, but not the left or the right one. The settings window and the game's Mod Options have them too.
chinese: 这些是 Viewpoint 自有的按键;游戏原版按键不变。点击按键即可修改,然后按下新按键(可搭配 Shift、Ctrl 或 Alt);按 Esc 保持原样。鼠标按键也可绑定,但左右键除外。设置窗口和游戏内模组选项里也都有这些设置。

english: The window a player sees when Viewpoint turns itself off after an error, with a test error in its report. First person stays on.
chinese: Viewpoint 出错自动关闭时玩家看到的窗口,报告中含一个测试错误。第一人称保持开启。
来自调试/设置引导的测试

english: Press a key or a button...
chinese: 按下一个按键或手柄按钮...

english: Modern draws the Default look: sun, lamp and flashlight shadows, clouds, light in the air, bloom and the effects below. Vanilla is a plain look close to the game's own, light on any graphics card.
chinese: 现代画质呈现完整效果:太阳、灯光和手电阴影,云,空气中的光,泛光及下方各项特效。原版画质接近游戏原生风格,任何显卡都能轻松运行。

english: Modern: the full look. Vanilla: a plain look for all graphics cards.
chinese: 现代:完整画质。原版:适合所有显卡的朴素画质。

english: The dead bodies within 40 squares as the game's own 3D models rather than flat pictures, as many as the level allows, with about a megabyte of memory for each. Extreme sets no count, and makes models of the bodies all round you, not only of those ahead.
chinese: 40 格内的尸体用游戏原生 3D 模型呈现而非平面贴图,数量随画质档位而定,每具约占 1 MB 内存。极限档不限数量,且四周的尸体都建模,不只是前方的。

english: Held, aims as the mouse's right button does, on foot in first and third person; the right stick still turns the view. The game does not see its button then: on LT, that is the game's Shove, which you move to another button in the game's own Options, Controller.
chinese: 按住时瞄准,效果同鼠标右键,步行时第一/第三人称均生效;右摇杆仍可转动视角。此时游戏看不到该按键:LT 默认是游戏原版的推搡,请到游戏自带选项的手柄页把它改到其他按键。

english: Press a button of your pad for
chinese: 为以下功能按下手柄按钮

english: The graphics settings have changes that are not applied.
chinese: 图形设置有尚未应用的更改。

english: It shows once the hardware is checked, as a save loads.
chinese: 存档加载、硬件检测完成后显示。

english: Sets all the settings below. A change to one of them makes it Custom.
chinese: 设置下方全部选项。修改任意一项会变为自定义。

english: Settings the rows above do not show.
chinese: 上方各行未显示的设置。

english: A Minecraft shader pack has options of its own: see Shader Options.
chinese: Minecraft 着色器包有它自己的选项:见着色器选项。

english: An upscaler from AMD, Intel or NVIDIA.
chinese: 来自 AMD、Intel 或 NVIDIA 的升采样器。

english: Blurs the picture as you turn and as things move. A higher level makes the blur smoother.
chinese: 视角转动和物体移动时画面产生模糊。等级越高模糊越平滑。

english: Blurs the picture when you turn or things move.
chinese: 视角转动或物体移动时画面产生模糊。

english: Blurs what is far behind the point you look at.
chinese: 你注视点后方远处的物体变模糊。

english: Bumps and shine on the ground and the walls.
chinese: 地面和墙壁的凹凸与光泽。

english: Faster with fewer pixels, or sharper with more.
chinese: 像素少则更快,像素多则更清晰。

english: Gives the ground and the walls the bumps and the shine of what they are made of: rough grass, soil and brick, smooth tiles and concrete. Off, they show the game's flat art, which is faster.
chinese: 给地面和墙壁它们材质应有的凹凸和光泽:粗糙的草、泥土和砖,光滑的瓷砖和混凝土。关闭后显示游戏平面贴图,性能更好。

english: Glare from the sun and from bright lights.
chinese: 太阳和强光产生的眩光。

english: Shade in corners and under objects.
chinese: 角落和物体下方的阴影。

english: Shade in corners, in creases and under things. A higher level makes the shade smoother and more exact.
chinese: 角落、褶皱和物体下方的阴影。等级越高阴影越平滑精确。

english: Shadows from the sun, the moon, the lamps and the flashlight.
chinese: 太阳、月亮、灯光和手电的阴影。

english: Smooths jagged edges. TAA+ blends each frame with the ones before: the steadiest image. TAA uses fewer frames. FXAA and SMAA smooth each frame on its own: sharp, but edges can still shimmer. When resolution scaling is on, this setting is off: the upscaler smooths the edges.
chinese: 平滑锯齿边缘。TAA+ 与之前帧混合:最稳定。TAA 使用更少帧。FXAA 和 SMAA 各自平滑每帧:锐利但边缘可能仍有闪烁。开启分辨率缩放时此设置关闭:由升采样器平滑边缘。

english: The resolution the upscaler draws the world at before it fills the screen. Performance modes draw fewer pixels and are faster; Quality modes are sharper. Native AA and DLAA draw at the screen's resolution and only smooth the edges.
chinese: 升采样器在填充屏幕前绘制世界的分辨率。性能模式像素更少更快;质量模式更清晰。原生 AA 和 DLAA 按屏幕分辨率绘制,只平滑边缘。

english: Uses an upscaler from a graphics card maker in place of the anti-aliasing. The upscaler smooths edges and makes a lower render resolution fill the screen. FSR 3 is from AMD, XeSS is from Intel, DLSS is from NVIDIA (RTX cards only). Choose its mode below.
chinese: 用显卡厂商的升采样器替代抗锯齿。升采样器平滑边缘并让较低渲染分辨率填满屏幕。FSR 3 来自 AMD,XeSS 来自 Intel,DLSS 来自 NVIDIA(仅 RTX 显卡)。在下方选择模式。

english: Volumetric clouds, and how finely they are drawn.
chinese: 体积云,及其绘制精细度。

english: How far past the loaded area the world is drawn.
chinese: 世界绘制超出已加载区域的距离。

english: How fine the game's art is. It changes when the game starts again.
chinese: 游戏美术资源的精细度。修改后需重启游戏生效。

english: Smoother movement from frames made between the frames drawn.
chinese: 在绘制帧之间生成的帧让运动更流畅。

english: Sets every setting below at once, and changing any of them makes it Custom.
chinese: 同时设置下方全部选项,修改任意一项会变为自定义。

english: Press a key (Esc: as it was)
chinese: 按下一个按键(Esc 保持原样)

english: Another key for it, besides those it has.
chinese: 给它另外指定一个按键。

english: Resolution scaling and frame generation use:
chinese: 分辨率缩放与帧生成使用:

english: NVIDIA DLSS and DLAA, through NVIDIA Streamline
chinese: NVIDIA DLSS 与 DLAA(通过 NVIDIA Streamline)

english: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3 (FSR 3) and its frame generation
chinese: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3(FSR 3)及其帧生成

english: Press a pad button (click: as it was)
chinese: 按下一个手柄按键(点击:保持原样)
打开我们的 Discord 服务器

english: Held while the free camera flies.
