english: A streak of light along each shot's way, by the gun: short and pale from a handgun, long and orange from a rifle, red from an automatic, a shotgun's pellets each its own. Low: your own shots only. Medium: everyone's. High and up: at night the newest light what they pass, more of them at each step.
chinese: 每发子弹沿弹道留下光迹:手枪短而淡，步枪长而橙，自动武器为红，霰弹每颗弹丸各有一条。低:仅自己的射击。中:所有人的。高及以上:夜间最新的光迹会照亮所经之处，档位越高数量越多。

english: A trail drop's radius against the running drop's: its water is taken from it.
chinese: 尾迹水滴半径相对流动水滴的比例:它的水由后者提供。

english: A vehicle on a slope of the terrain relief is drawn tilted to the ground under its wheels, up to this; its physics, and what everyone else's game sees of it, stay the game's own.
chinese: 载具位于地形起伏的斜坡上时，最多按车轮下的地面倾斜到该角度；其物理与他人看到的姿态仍是游戏本身。

english: A yellow dot on each head lamp's lens and a line along its beam, a red one on each tail or brake light, and a short cyan line the way each lamp's glass faces, drawn over everything.
chinese: 每个车头灯镜片上有黄点、沿光柱有黄线；每个尾灯/刹车灯为红点；每个灯罩朝向有短青线，均绘制在最上层。

english: Aiming a gun on a pad, in first and third person, the view is helped onto a zombie near the crosshair. The shot still goes exactly where the crosshair is. Never onto a player.
chinese: 用手柄持枪瞄准（第一/第三人称）时，视角会辅助吸附到准星附近的丧尸身上。子弹仍严格打向准星位置，且从不吸附玩家。

english: An experiment: how far a blade seen edge on near you turns towards you, so a lawn looks fuller from low down. Its root and the wind stay as they are.
chinese: 实验项:近处侧刃草叶朝你转向的幅度，让低视角下草坪更饱满。草根与风力不受影响。

english: As you start to aim, the view eases onto the chest of a zombie near the crosshair.
chinese: 开始瞄准时，视角平滑移到准星附近丧尸的胸口。

english: Asks the game for the 3D models of the objects and items in the loaded area before they first show, a little each frame, the nearest first: no object appears late, and the first switch to first person finds them loaded.
chinese: 在物体首次显示前向游戏请求已加载区域的 3D 模型，每帧处理一点、由近及远:物体不会迟显，首次切第一人称时模型已就绪。

english: At most this many corpses are 3D models, and no more than the posed corpses' pool holds (Cap: posed corpses, below; about 1.2 MiB a corpse). With fewer, the models thin out along the whole view rather than stopping short of its distance.
chinese: 最多这么多尸体使用 3D 模型，且不超过姿态尸体池容量（见下方「上限:姿态尸体」，每具约 1.2 MiB）。数量更少时，模型均匀稀疏到整个视野而非在距离处截断。

english: At the fixed tick, the game's windows and HUD updated and drawn for the frames between the game's steps, where the main thread has the time: hover, drags and scrolling at the screen's rate. Off, they answer at the tick's rate.
chinese: 固定步长下，游戏窗口与 HUD 在主线程有余力的帧里更新绘制:悬停、拖动、滚动都按屏幕刷新率响应。关闭则按步长频率响应。

english: At the next load of a save with the game's Texture compression off, the setup holds first person for it as on a card too small, whatever this card has. Its button turns compression on and quits the game.
chinese: 下次读取「关闭材质压缩」的存档时，设置向导会像对待显存不足的显卡一样等待处理。其按钮会开启压缩并退出游戏。

english: Beside the interaction menu, what the game's own menu shows on hovering the action chosen, where it tells what the menu does not: why an action is refused, or the tools, skill and materials it needs. Off: the menu alone.
chinese: 在交互菜单旁显示游戏自带菜单在悬停该动作时的说明，补充菜单没有的信息:动作为何被拒绝，或所需的工具、技能与材料。关闭:只显示菜单。

english: Blades of grass grown over the green ground round you, bending in the wind, pushed aside by what walks through them, laid flat under vehicles, and thrown about by shots and blasts: town lawns short, the wild grass tall. Each step reaches further with more blades, on the graphics card's time.
chinese: 在你周围绿地上生成草叶:随风摆动、被人踩开、被载具压平、被射击与爆炸掀动；城镇草坪低矮，野外草高。档位越高范围越大、草叶越多，消耗显卡时间。

english: Blades whose square the near world's light grids hold none for are drawn magenta: they take the open sky's light, not the ground's under them.
chinese: 近景光照网格未覆盖到的格子里的草叶会画成品红:它们取天空光而非地面光。

english: Breathing sway, affected by aiming skill, endurance, fatigue, panic, movement and weapon weight.
chinese: 呼吸晃动，受瞄准技能、耐力、疲劳、恐慌、移动与武器重量影响。

english: Builds and keeps every loaded chunk whether it is in view or not, so the hills about you cast their shadows as you turn; costs the main thread the building, and the pools room.
chinese: 无论是否在视野内，都构建并保留所有已加载区块，使你转身时周围山丘仍有阴影；代价是主线程构建开销与内存池占用。

english: Builds the world first and third person show while the game's loading screen waits, and holds its click to start until it is done, so the first switch shows it whole at once.
chinese: 在游戏载入界面等待时预先构建第一/第三人称世界，并在完成前不响应开始点击，使首次切换即完整显示。

english: Bushes and trees between the camera and the character dissolve, as models do. Only with the models' dissolve on.
chinese: 相机与角色之间的灌木和树木像模型一样溶解。仅在模型溶解开启时有效。

english: Colours each item's tile by what kind of thing it is (weapons, ammunition, equipment, medical, food and drink, tools, materials, books and maps), as Tarkov colours its grid, each in the colour chosen below, and your junk in its own whatever its kind. Other things stay plain. Its condition shows on the border.
chinese: 按物品种类给格子着色（武器、弹药、装备、医疗、食物饮料、工具、材料、书籍地图），像《逃离塔科夫》那样，各类颜色见下方；杂物无论种类都用自己的颜色。其他物品保持原样，状态显示在描边上。

english: Compiles on the loading screen the shaders a change of the built-in packs' settings asks for, so the change shows at once in place of after seconds. Compiled once, then kept with the rest.
chinese: 在载入界面预编译内置包设置改动所需的着色器，使改动立即生效而非等待数秒。只编译一次，之后与其他着色器一并保留。

english: Day and night follow the game's own clock and light, as in the isometric view: when it gets dark, how dark it gets, where the sun and the moon stand, and the moon's phase. Off: the sun, the moon and the light follow the real sky over Kentucky.
chinese: 昼夜跟随游戏自身的时钟与光照，与等距视角一致:何时变暗、暗到什么程度、日月位置与月相。关闭时日月与光照跟随肯塔基真实天象。

english: Decodes the sound files the game's sound scripts name (mods' sounds) as a save loads, on a thread of its own, so a sound plays the first time without a hitch. Within the cap of the sound files' memory (World, Memory).
chinese: 读档时在独立线程解码游戏音效脚本引用的音频（模组音效），使首次播放不卡顿。受「音效文件内存上限」限制（世界 → 内存）。

english: Dev mode only. Checks the meshes round the player against the newest recording (TESTING.md).
chinese: 仅开发者模式。用最新录制数据校验玩家周围的网格 (TESTING.md)。

english: Dev mode only. Explains the wall under the free cursor, or the crosshair: what each of its faces shows and why (console, screen).
chinese: 仅开发者模式。解释自由光标或准星所指的墙体:每个面显示什么及原因（控制台/屏幕）。

english: Dev mode only. Normal, the art only, the light only, the volumetric light, the bounce light, the lamps' shadows, the sun's maps.
chinese: 仅开发者模式。正常、仅美术、仅光照、体积光、反弹光、灯光阴影、太阳贴图。

english: Dev mode only. Records the mesher round the player (TESTING.md).
chinese: 仅开发者模式。录制玩家周围的网格生成 (TESTING.md)。

english: Dev mode only. Starts and stops recording the third-person camera's frames, for the offline checks (TESTING.md).
chinese: 仅开发者模式。启停第三人称相机帧录制，用于离线校验 (TESTING.md)。

english: Dev mode only. The culling of the rooms no one can see: on, frozen, off.
chinese: 仅开发者模式。不可见房间的剔除:开、冻结、关。

english: Dev mode only. The renderer's effects off one at a time.
chinese: 仅开发者模式。逐个关闭渲染特效。

english: Directions and steps taken round each pixel, as XeGTAO's presets a step down: Medium (1 x 2) is about half Ultra's time (3 x 3), High (2 x 2) two thirds; Extreme (9 x 3) the least noise for about twice Ultra's.
chinese: 每个像素周围的取样方向与步数，相当于 XeGTAO 预设降一档:中 (1x2) 约为超高 (3x3) 的一半耗时，高 (2x2) 为三分之二；极致 (9x3) 噪点最少，耗时约为超高的两倍。

english: Draws the ring the crosshair wanders within, from the game's hit chance, and where each shot went in the world. For checking the aim; nothing is drawn while not aiming a firearm.
chinese: 绘制由游戏命中率决定的准星游走环，以及每发子弹在世界中的落点。用于校验瞄准；未持枪瞄准时不绘制。

english: Draws the sides of a wide view closer to their true size: upright lines stay straight, the middle is drawn larger.
chinese: 把宽视野的边缘拉近真实尺寸:竖线保持笔直，中心区域画得更大。

english: Driving, in first and third person, the view goes back to the way the vehicle goes when the mouse has been still a while. Moving the mouse takes it back at once.
chinese: 驾驶时（第一/第三人称），鼠标静止一段时间后视角自动回正到车头方向。移动鼠标立即接管。

english: Each depth along a line blended to where its ray passes between two pixels, the pixel shading and casting from that one depth (Bend's offset mode): steadier lines on smooth surfaces, more jagged ones in places; off, each pixel casts from the further of its two.
chinese: 沿线条的各深度按射线在两像素间的通过位置混合，像素按该深度着色与投射（Bend 偏移模式）:平滑表面上线条更稳，个别处更锯齿；关闭时每个像素从较远的那个深度投射。

english: Each frame shows the world about a step behind the game's newest, its characters and vehicles placed between its last steps, and carried on along their last step while the next is late: off, at the newest, as the game draws it.
chinese: 每帧显示比游戏最新状态滞后约一步的世界，角色与载具插值在上一步之间，下一步迟到时沿上一步外推；关闭时按游戏绘制的最新状态显示。

english: Each shot climbs the view and pushes it a little sideways. Part of it settles back, the rest stays: hold the gun down on full auto. Every weapon kicks its own way (pistols snap, rifles push, snipers and shotguns punch).
chinese: 每发子弹让视角上抬并向一侧轻推。一部分会回正，其余保留:全自动时需要压枪。每种武器后坐方式不同（手枪弹跳、步枪推、狙击与霰弹猛击）。

english: Each step runs this many ticks, at the tick rate divided by it: tells the Lua modes apart.
chinese: 每个步长执行这么多 tick，tick 频率除以该值:用于区分 Lua 模式。

english: Each zombie's bones for drawing worked out by Viewpoint's own code from the game's animations, the same math as the game's: the same pose in less of the main thread's time. A zombie the code cannot pose (a ragdoll, its first frame) is posed by the game as before.
chinese: 每只丧尸的绘制骨骼由 Viewpoint 自己按游戏的动画数据计算，数学与游戏一致:相同姿势占用更少主线程时间。无法计算的（布娃娃、首帧）仍由游戏摆姿势。

english: Each zombie's skeleton copied once each time the game moves it, the graphics card blending its pose between those copies for every frame drawn and working out what each piece it wears takes from it: in a crowd the main thread does not, and the far ones move smoothly between their updates.
chinese: 游戏每次移动丧尸时复制一次骨骼，显卡在两次复制之间为每一帧混合姿势，并计算其穿戴各部件如何跟随:人群时主线程不再计算，远处丧尸在更新间隔间平滑移动。

english: Edge pixels cast no shadow: thinner shadows from leaves and thin things, none from a blade of grass whose march runs along it.
chinese: 边缘像素不投射阴影:树叶等细薄物体阴影更纤细，草叶沿其走向不投影。

english: Enables the calibration window, extra logging and the validator.
chinese: 启用校准窗口、额外日志与校验器。

english: Every lamp lights the world the way a real one does: street lamps throw their light down into a pool under the head, ceiling lights fill rooms from above, fires shine all round, light falls off with distance and bounces back up off the ground. Lamps far down the street light the road too. 0: Viewpoint's lamps.
chinese: 每盏灯按真实方式照明:路灯把光投成灯下的一滩，吸顶灯自上而下充满房间，火堆四周发光，光随距离衰减并从地面反弹。远处的路灯也会照亮路面。0 表示使用 Viewpoint 的灯光。

english: Falling rain and wet air spread the light of lamps and headlights into a soft glow.
chinese: 落雨与潮湿空气把灯光和车灯晕成柔和光晕。

english: Fast: Medium and High read a pixel in four at half the size each way, with 3 and 5 pairs of samples; Ultra every pixel with 5, Extreme every pixel with 12. Ground truth: directions and steps round each pixel, as XeGTAO's presets a step down: Medium (1 x 2) about half Ultra's time (3 x 3), High (2 x 2) two thirds, Extreme (9 x 3) the least noise for about twice Ultra's.
chinese: 快速:中与高把像素按四分之一大小读取，分别取 3 与 5 对样本；超高每像素 5 个，极致每像素 12 个。基准:按每像素方向与步数，相当于 XeGTAO 预设降一档:中 (1x2) 约超高 (3x3) 一半耗时，高 (2x2) 三分之二，极致 (9x3) 噪点最少、耗时约两倍。

english: Fine moving grain in dark scenes, like a camera at night.
chinese: 暗场景中的细密动态颗粒，像夜间相机。

english: For a strong PC: every corpse in view, within the distance above, is a 3D model, however many lie there, in place of Most 3D corpses. The posed corpses' pool still bounds them, about 1.2 MiB a corpse: raise its cap (below) for a big pile.
chinese: 适合高配:视野内、上述距离内的所有尸体都用 3D 模型，无论有多少具，替代「最多 3D 尸体」。仍受姿态尸体池限制（每具约 1.2 MiB）:尸体堆很大就调高下方上限。

english: For how long after the blade lets go a dragged drop stays put, its water held to the glass.
chinese: 雨刷离开后，被拖拽的水滴停留多久（水附着在玻璃上）。

english: For this session: a console line each time the game's fishing changes state (its stage, the gauge, aiming, the action queue, the bobber), to tell where it stood if it sticks.
chinese: 本次会话内:游戏钓鱼状态改变（阶段、进度、瞄准、动作队列、浮标）时输出一行控制台日志，卡住时可判断停在哪一步。

english: Frame times, how busy each thread and the GPU are, and what holds the frame rate back, in the top right corner: all of it, one line, the graph alone, or off.
chinese: 右上角显示帧耗时、各线程与 GPU 负载、以及帧率受限原因:全部、单行、仅图表、或关闭。

english: Frees about 16 MB of video memory, and as much of the system's commit, a chunk the isometric view has drawn; that view draws them all again when it comes back, and the game stops for a second or so each time. For a graphics card short of memory.
chinese: 释放等距视角已绘制区块的约 16 MB 显存及相应系统提交内存；回到等距视角时会全部重绘，每次游戏卡顿约一秒。适合显存不足的显卡。

english: Further than this, one colour for every four squares, a sixteenth of the memory.
chinese: 超过该距离时每四格只用一种颜色，内存占用降到十六分之一。

english: Ground truth: XeGTAO's, the more exact, with the way the sky is seen most; smooth only under the TAA. Fast: Intel's ASSAO, cheaper and steady on its own, for playing without the TAA.
chinese: 基准:采用 XeGTAO，更精确、天空表现最好；仅在 TAA 下平滑。快速:采用 Intel ASSAO，开销更低且自身稳定，适合不开 TAA 时游玩。

english: Guns with a bipod (Guns of Marz, Gael's Gun Store, VFE M60) put it down by the gun pack's own action when you go prone or rest the gun on something, and fold it when you walk off. The Bipod key in Options > Keybinds toggles it by hand.
chinese: 带两脚架的枪（Guns of Marz、Gael's Gun Store、VFE M60）在趴下或架枪时按枪包自身动作展开，走开时收起。也可用「选项 > 按键 > 两脚架」手动切换。

english: Held all the way across a moment, the turn quickens, to turn round faster.
chinese: 持续按住一个时刻，转向会加快，便于快速转身。

english: Held, aims as the mouse's right button does, on foot in first and third person; the right stick still turns the view. The game does not see its button then: on LT, that is the game's Shove, which you move to another button in the game's own Options, Controller. With a fishing line out, LT lets line out and RT reels in, whichever button aims.
chinese: 按住时等效于鼠标右键瞄准（第一/第三人称步行）；右摇杆仍可转视角。此时游戏看不到该按键:若在 LT 上，那是游戏的「推搡」，可在游戏自身「选项 > 手柄」里改绑。钓鱼放线时 LT 放线、RT 收线，与瞄准键无关。

english: Hides the sidebar's icons while Viewpoint's inventory screen is up (Tab), and shows them again as it closes, as set below.
chinese: Viewpoint 背包界面（Tab）打开时隐藏侧边栏图标，关闭时恢复，详见下方设置。

english: How a column lists its items when the screen first opens and after this changes; the button beside each search switches it.
chinese: 界面首次打开及此项改变后，各列列出物品的方式；搜索框旁的按钮也能切换。

english: How a sound's direction is heard. Steam Audio renders each sound for your two ears with a head-related transfer function, so sounds above, below and behind you are told apart; it needs the Headphones output and Valve's files. FMOD's basic panning is the game's own, from left to right. Applies to sounds that start after the change.
chinese: 声音方向的听感方式。Steam Audio 用头相关传递函数为双耳渲染，能分辨上下与身后；需要「耳机」输出与 Valve 的音效文件。FMOD 基础声像即游戏自带的左右定位。仅对改动之后开始播放的声音生效。

english: How bright lights inside buildings are: rooms' ceiling lights and lamps indoors (1: as the game sets them). Needs Realistic lights.
chinese: 室内灯光的亮度:房间吸顶灯与室内台灯（1 表示与游戏设置一致）。需要开启「真实灯光」。

english: How bright the head lamps are, against a sealed halogen low beam's.
chinese: 车头灯亮度（相对密封卤素近光灯）。

english: How bright the image is before the tone curve. The eye's own correction works on top of it.
chinese: 色调曲线之前的画面亮度。眼睛的自动适应会叠加在其上。

english: How bright the tail and brake lights are; 0 none.
chinese: 尾灯与刹车灯亮度；0 表示不亮。

english: How close two drops join into one: a share of their radii together.
chinese: 两滴水滴多近会合并:以两者半径之和的比例表示。

english: How dark the corners of the image go, as a lens darkens them.
chinese: 画面四角变暗的程度，如同镜头暗角。

english: How dark the lines are, from a faint pencil to near black.
chinese: 线条深浅，从淡铅笔到接近全黑。

english: How dark the screen's columns and panels are. Lower shows more of the world through them; under 0.6 the words cast a shadow to stay readable.
chinese: 界面各列与面板的暗度。数值越低越能透出世界；低于 0.6 时文字会加投影以保证可读。

english: How deep the shade is (1: as XeGTAO matches its ray-traced reference, 0: none).
chinese: 阴影深度（1 表示与 XeGTAO 的光追基准一致，0 表示无）。

english: How far a lit floor's light bounces, in squares: a wider, smoother bounce for more time.
chinese: 受光地面反弹光的范围（格）:范围越大越平滑，耗时越多。

english: How far a pixel's depth may stand off the line through its two neighbours across the march and still be blended with them: past it, an edge. A plane seen at a slant is none.
chinese: 像素深度偏离相邻两像素连线多少以内仍与之混合:超出即为边缘。倾斜观察的平面不参与。

english: How far a running drop runs between two of the small drops it leaves behind it.
chinese: 流动水滴每留下两颗小水滴之间跑过的距离。

english: How far above its usual height the camera stands, in every state (squares; below 0, lower). The camera still looks where you look, so the character sits lower on the screen.
chinese: 相机相对其常规高度的抬升（格；小于 0 则降低）。相机仍看向你的视线方向，因此角色在屏幕上位置更低。

english: How far ahead of the rubber a dragged drop rides, against its radius.
chinese: 被拖拽的水滴领先雨刷多少（相对其半径）。

english: How far ahead the sound is mixed: the shorter, the sooner a sound is heard after what makes it, the more a slow or busy computer may crackle. Takes effect when the game starts next.
chinese: 声音提前混音的时长:越短，声音越即时，但慢机器或繁忙时更容易爆音。下次启动游戏生效。

english: How far apart the lanes are.
How far behind the character the camera stands, in every state. The character keeps its size on the screen whatever the third-person field of view.
chinese: 相机相对角色后退的距离。无论第三人称视野如何，角色在屏幕上的大小不变。

english: How far below level the head lamps point, in degrees: higher brings the bright part of the beam on the road nearer the car. Real low beams are aimed about half a degree to a degree down.
chinese: 车头灯向下的角度（度）:数值越大，路面上的亮区越靠近车身。真实近光灯通常下倾约 0.5 到 1 度。

english: How far each drop's drawn water reaches out to join its neighbours' (its radii): more makes nearby drops look like one body of water. Every pane's water.
chinese: 每颗水滴绘制的水体向外延伸与相邻水滴相接的范围（以半径计）:越大，邻近水滴越像一整片水。作用于所有玻璃。

english: How far from the eye they are gone.
chinese: 距离视点多远处完全消失。

english: How far from the eye they start to fade out: further off the depth is too coarse for them and stripes flat ground, and the shadow maps hold that detail.
chinese: 距离视点多远开始淡出:更远处深度精度不足会在地面上产生条纹，那部分改由阴影贴图表达。

english: How far from the player a corpse may be a 3D model. The chance of a corpse being a model falls with its distance from the player's feet, and over its last squares (Fade band) the models dissolve to the flat pictures. At most 40: the ring of chunks the models are drawn in.
chinese: 尸体距离玩家多远以内可用 3D 模型。越远概率越低，最后一段（淡出带）模型会溶解为平面贴图。最多 40:模型所在区块环的范围。

english: How far in front of an obstacle the muzzle starts giving way.
chinese: 枪口在障碍物前多远开始让步。

english: How far in front of your eye the gun sits when aiming down sights. Higher = smaller front sight, more of the target visible and less of your hands near the camera, but past about 1.3 the arms stretch to reach. Pistols are not affected. Does not change where you hit.
chinese: 开镜时枪械距眼睛多远。数值越大准星越小、目标可见更多、眼前的手更少；超过约 1.3 手臂会明显拉伸。手枪不受影响。不影响命中位置。

english: How far round a point its occluders are looked for, against the default (about a square and a half): wider, softer shade from larger things.
chinese: 在某点周围多大范围搜索遮挡物（相对默认约 1.5 格）:越大，大型物体产生的阴影越柔和。

english: How far round you the grass stands at its full number of blades.
chinese: 你周围多远内草保持完整密度。

english: How far the grass reaches against the quality's, at most 120 squares: past the world the game keeps loaded round you (about 50 squares) it grows from the map's files. Farther off the grass is the ground's colour, painted as the blades make it.
chinese: 草的覆盖范围（相对画质档，最多 120 格）:超出游戏在你周围保持加载的范围（约 50 格）后，草由地图文件生成。更远处以地面颜色表现草的效果。

english: How far the gun pulls back and rises when it meets something.
chinese: 枪械命中物体后回收与上抬的幅度。

english: How far the left wiper reaches from its pivot: a share of the windscreen's width. A blade longer than the windscreen is high stops short of upright, its tip under the top.
chinese: 左雨刷从支点伸出的长度:占挡风宽度比例。若长于挡风高度，则刮不到竖直位置，刷尖停在顶部下方。

english: How far the night turns blue and grey as your eyes adapt to the dark, while lamps keep their colour (1: as the eye's rods do it, 0: none).
chinese: 眼睛适应黑暗时夜色偏蓝灰的程度，灯光仍保留本色（1 模拟视杆细胞效果，0 表示无）。

english: How far the right stick moves before the view turns: raise it if the view drifts with the stick let go.
chinese: 右摇杆移动多少才转视角:松手后视角仍漂移就调高此项。

english: How far the right wiper reaches, the same way.
chinese: 右雨刷的伸出长度，含义同上。

english: How far the view is taken from flat (0.1) towards the full Panini projection (1).
chinese: 视角从平面 (0.1) 过渡到完整 Panini 投影 (1) 的程度。

english: How far the water has waves, reflections and depth. Loaded: only the area near you. Shells: also the nearer distant land. All: also the farthest distant land. The other water shows its map colour.
chinese: 水面有多远具备波浪、反射与深度。已加载:仅你附近的区域。外壳:还包括较近的远景陆地。全部:包括最远的远景陆地。其余水面显示地图颜色。

english: How far the wind bends the blades against its own.
chinese: 风力让草叶弯曲的幅度（相对其自身值）。

english: How fast drops gather the fine rain round them against their own.
chinese: 水滴收集周围细雨的速度（相对其自身值）。

english: How fast it is drawn to it.
How fast the blades sway in the wind against their own.
chinese: 草叶随风摆动的速度（相对其自身值）。

english: How fast the blades thin out past that: 2 keeps as many on the screen far off as near, less keeps more far off. The blades left are wider, to cover the ground as the rest did.
chinese: 超过该距离后草叶稀疏的速度:2 表示屏上远近密度相同，更小则远处保留更多。剩余草叶会加宽以覆盖地面。

english: How fast the right stick turns the view across, pushed all the way, in first and third person. While aiming, Aim sensitivity (Controls, Third person) scales it.
chinese: 右摇杆推到底时横向转视角的快慢（第一/第三人称）。瞄准时由「瞄准灵敏度」（操控 → 第三人称）缩放。

english: How fast the right stick turns the view up and down, pushed all the way.
chinese: 右摇杆推到底时俯仰转视角的快慢。

english: How fast the rivulets run against the car's speed.
chinese: 细水流的速度（相对车速）。

english: How fast the view turns while aiming, on top of the zoom's own: 1 keeps a turn the same across the screen however far the view is zoomed in. A pad's stick takes it in first person too.
chinese: 瞄准时转视角的快慢（在倍率之上）:1 表示无论放大多少，屏幕上的转向手感一致。第一人称下同样作用于手柄摇杆。

english: How fast they run at the most.
How large the line's tension gauge is, left of the crosshair while the line is out: 1 is the game's own gauge's size on a 1080p screen, and it grows with a larger screen.
chinese: 鱼线张力表的大小（放线时显示在准星左侧）:1 为 1080p 下游戏自带尺寸，屏幕更大时随之放大。

english: How light the image is after the tone curve, for a screen darker or lighter than the one the look was set on. The exposure above works before the curve and changes how the highlights roll off; this does not.
chinese: 色调曲线之后的画面亮度，用于屏幕比设定时更亮或更暗的情况。上方曝光作用在曲线之前并影响高光滚降；此项不会。

english: How long a cell the blade wiped takes to bead again at full rain, on the windscreen.
chinese: 满雨量时，挡风玻璃上被雨刷刮过的区域重新布满水珠所需时间。

english: How long a dragged drop keeps its way once the blade slows or turns.
chinese: 雨刷减速或转向后，被拖拽的水滴保持原轨迹的时长。

english: How long a stroke up and back takes, for both wipers, at every rain.
chinese: 两个雨刷一次上行并复位的耗时，各雨量下一致。

english: How long an arc is along the sweep.
chinese: 刀光弧沿扫掠方向的长度。

english: How long an arc lasts after the blade passed.
chinese: 刀片经过后刀光弧的存留时长。

english: How long the camera takes to move between the isometric view and first or third person; 0 switches at once.
chinese: 相机在等距视角与第一/第三人称之间移动的耗时；0 为立即切换。

english: How long the game's picture and Viewpoint's dissolve into each other at the isometric end of the switch.
chinese: 切换回等距视角一端时，游戏画面与 Viewpoint 画面互相溶解的时长。

english: How long they rest at the foot between strokes in heavy rain.
chinese: 大雨时雨刷在底部两次挥动间的停顿。

english: How long they rest between strokes in a drizzle.
chinese: 细雨时雨刷两次挥动间的停顿。

english: How long they rest between strokes in rain.
chinese: 中雨时雨刷两次挥动间的停顿。

english: How long your character's animation pauses when a melee blow lands, so the blow has weight. The time is made up at once after, so attacks last as long as without it. 0 turns it off.
chinese: 近战命中时角色动画的停顿，使打击更有分量。停顿时间会立即补回，攻击总时长不变。0 表示关闭。

english: How many of the nearest cars' headlights cast shadows: what stands in a car's beams (people, zombies, other cars, fences) darkens the road behind it, and its beams in the air are cut by it. Your own car first; a car further off has a smaller shadow map, drawn less often.
chinese: 最近多少辆车的车灯投射阴影:光束中的人、丧尸、车辆、围栏会在其后路面留下阴影，空中的光柱也会被切断。优先本车；更远的车阴影贴图更小、更新更少。

english: How many times a second the game updates its world while the fixed tick is on.
chinese: 开启固定步长时，游戏每秒更新世界的次数。

english: How much a melee swing moves the camera, and how hard a blow jolts it when it lands, in first and third person.
chinese: 近战挥击带动相机的幅度，以及命中时的震动强度（第一/第三人称）。

english: How much a shot kicks the camera, in first and third person. Where the shot goes does not change.
chinese: 射击带动相机的幅度（第一/第三人称）。不影响命中位置。

english: How much a shot kicks the gun and the arms that hold it, in first and third person. Where the shot goes does not change.
chinese: 射击带动枪械与手臂的幅度（第一/第三人称）。不影响命中位置。

english: How much colour your eyes keep in the dark once they are used to it: the eye's night cells see no colour. 0: the dark all grey; 1: its colour kept.
chinese: 眼睛适应黑暗后仍保留的颜色:人眼暗视觉本无颜色。0 为全灰，1 为保留颜色。

english: How much farther than in the isometric view a weapon's ranges reach in first and third person: its best range, how its hit chance falls off past it, and the point blank. The isometric view shows distances short, and the game's ranges are made for it. 1 is the game's own.
chinese: 第一/第三人称下武器射程相对等距视角的补偿倍数:最佳射程、超出后的命中衰减、以及贴脸距离。等距视角会把距离显示得更近，游戏射程也据此设定。1 表示与游戏一致。

english: How much further out over the shoulder the camera stands (squares; below 0, nearer the middle). It follows the shoulder when the camera swaps.
chinese: 相机过肩外移的距离（格；小于 0 更靠中间）。换肩时相机随之切换。

english: How much light the lit floors round about bounce onto walls, ceilings and things (1: as the light model gives it, 0: none). Only with global illumination on.
chinese: 周围受光地面把光反弹到墙壁、天花板和物体上的强度（1 为光照模型值，0 为无）。需开启全局光照。

english: How much light the sky gives before sunrise and after sunset. 1: a real twilight, about half of daylight as the sun rises, still enough to see by when it is 6 degrees down (about half an hour before sunrise and after sunset), dark an hour and a quarter out. 0: Viewpoint's sky alone (very dark around sunrise and sunset). 2: the game's own long twilight (light for over three hours either side).
chinese: 日出前与日落后天空的光量。1 为真实晨昏:日出时约为白天一半，太阳低于地平 6 度（日出前/日落后约半小时）仍能视物，一小时一刻后转暗。0 为仅 Viewpoint 天空（日出日落前后很暗）。2 为游戏自带的长晨昏（两侧各三个多小时有光）。

english: How much memory the game may use. The game takes it as it starts.
chinese: 游戏可用的内存上限。启动时生效。

english: How much more the glass holds it then, against a drop at rest.
chinese: 此时玻璃对水滴的附着程度（相对静止水滴）。

english: How much of a bigger drop's way one beside it takes, so they move together.
chinese: 相邻小水滴跟随大水滴轨迹的比例，使它们一起移动。

english: How much of a zombie's movement across the view the view follows while the crosshair is on it: 0 none, 1 all of it. A zombie standing still is never pulled to.
chinese: 准星在丧尸身上时，视角跟随其横向移动的程度:0 不跟随，1 完全跟随。静止的丧尸不会吸引视角。

english: How much of the flashlight's light the surfaces it lands on bounce back round about (1: as the light model gives it, 0: none). Only with global illumination on.
chinese: 手电照到的表面向四周反弹的光量（1 为光照模型值，0 为无）。需开启全局光照。

english: How much of the flashlight's light the walls, floors and things it lands on bounce back into the room round about. 0: none.
chinese: 手电照到的墙、地面与物体把光反弹回房间的强度。0 表示无。

english: How much slower the right stick turns the view while the crosshair is over a zombie's body, so it stops on it: 0 not at all.
chinese: 准星在丧尸身上时右摇杆转视角的减速幅度，便于停住；0 表示不减速。

english: How much the camera moves on its own, in first and third person: how much a melee swing, a blow, a shot, a landing or a hit taken kick and shake it, and in third person the drift of a camera held by hand, the bob of the steps and the lean into turns. Off keeps the camera still. Lower it if the motion makes you feel unwell.
chinese: 相机自身运动的总强度（第一/第三人称）:挥击、打击、射击、落地、受击的带动与晃动，以及第三人称下手持相机的漂移、走路起伏与转向倾斜。关闭则相机保持稳定。若感到不适可调低。

english: How much the camera shakes when you are hit, bitten or land hard, and with explosions and thunder near, in first and third person.
chinese: 受击、被咬、重落地以及附近爆炸与雷声时相机的晃动幅度（第一/第三人称）。

english: How much the deepest shade is filled with flat ink, as a comic's inker fills it.
chinese: 最暗部被平涂墨色填充的程度，像漫画上墨。

english: How much the field of view changes: wider when running, narrower when aiming.
chinese: 视野变化的幅度:奔跑时变宽，瞄准时变窄。

english: How much the light falls in steps, shade, half light and full light, as an illustrator lays it, and how much the edges of people and cars catch the light behind them. 0: the light as it falls.
chinese: 光照被分成暗、半亮、全亮几档的程度，如同插画打光；以及人与车辆边缘被背光勾边的强度。0 表示按真实光照衰减。

english: How much the light falls into a few flat bands of brightness, as a colourist lays it. 0: smooth.
chinese: 光照被压成几档平涂亮度的程度，如同上色师处理。0 表示平滑过渡。

english: How much the upscaler sharpens the image it makes: 0 not at all, 0.25 as FSR 1 does, 1 the most. FSR 3 sharpens in its own pass, DLSS and XeSS through AMD's sharpening after them.
chinese: 升采样器对成品的锐化强度:0 不锐化，0.25 相当于 FSR 1，1 最强。FSR 3 自带锐化通道，DLSS 与 XeSS 通过后续的 AMD 锐化实现。

english: How much work the view inside scopes and sights costs. All levels only draw the part of the world the lens shows. High: everything, every frame (rain and object outlines in the lens too). Mid: no rain particles or outlines inside the lens. Low: like Mid, but the lens picture is redrawn every other frame (can lag a little when turning fast).
chinese: 镜内画面的开销。各档都只绘制镜片显示的那部分世界。高:全部内容每帧绘制（镜内也有雨滴与描边）。中:镜内不绘制雨滴与描边。低:同中，但镜内画面隔帧重绘（快速转向时略有延迟）。

english: How opaque the aim ring is. 1 is fully opaque.
chinese: 瞄准环的不透明度。1 为完全不透明。

english: How sharply a pixel goes into shadow as an occluder nears its depth.
chinese: 遮挡物接近该像素深度时转入阴影的锐利程度。

english: How sights are raised with a firearm. DayZ style: click the aim button (right mouse) to bring the sights up and keep them there, click again to lower them; hold it for ordinary hip aiming. Leave the game's own 'Toggle aim' option off with it.
chinese: 持枪抬镜的方式。DayZ 风格:点一下瞄准键（鼠标右键）抬起并保持，再点一下放下；按住则为普通腰射。使用该模式时请关闭游戏自带的「切换瞄准」选项。

english: How solid the ring is: lower lets the water show through it.
chinese: 水环的实心程度:越低越能透出水面。

english: How strongly the head lamps' beams show in the air, in dust, mist and rain; 0 none.
chinese: 车灯光柱在空气、尘埃、雾与雨中的可见强度；0 表示不显示。

english: How strongly the sun's and the moon's light shows in a room's dusty air, from each window or open door it comes in by.
chinese: 日月光在室内尘埃空气中的可见强度（按其射入的每扇窗与敞开门口计算）。

english: How strongly the sun's and the moon's light shows in a room's dusty air, from each window or open door it comes in by, as a shaft from the opening to where it lands. 1 is a shaft that reads against the wall behind it.
chinese: 日月光在室内尘埃空气中形成的可见光柱强度（从开口到落点）。1 表示在背景墙上清晰可辨。

english: How strongly the weather colours the picture.
chinese: 天气对画面的调色强度。

english: How tall the relief stands, times the real ground's. The roads' and banks' limits hold at the height the relief was built at: rebake to hold them at another.
chinese: 地形起伏的高度（相对真实地面的倍数）。道路与堤岸的限制按烘焙时的高度成立:改高度需重新烘焙。

english: How the grass, bushes and small plants round you stand: one card turned to face you, or two or three planes crossed through the plant, which look the same from every side.
chinese: 周围草、灌木与小植物的呈现方式:单面片朝向你，或两三张面片交叉穿透植株（各方向观感一致）。

english: How the scene's light becomes the screen's. ACES: the film industry's curve, contrast through the middle tones and a long roll into white, Somber's own. Filmic: vivid's, with more contrast. Neutral: Khronos PBR Neutral, colours as the art has them. Tony: Tony McMapface, soft and natural, the brightest going white as the eye sees them. Uncharted 2: John Hable's film curve, a long soft roll into white, bright colours paler. GT: Gran Turismo's curve, a straight middle between a toe and a shoulder, which keeps the shadows richer than the film curves do.
chinese: 场景光照如何转为屏幕画面。ACES:影视行业曲线，中间调有对比、向白过渡长，Somber 采用。Filmic:vivid 的曲线，对比更强。Neutral:Khronos PBR Neutral，颜色贴近美术原意。Tony:Tony McMapface，柔和自然，最亮处按人眼观感压向白色。Uncharted 2:John Hable 的电影曲线，向白过渡长而柔，亮色偏淡。GT:Gran Turismo 曲线，中段近乎直线，暗部比电影曲线保留更多细节。

english: How the scene's light becomes the screen's. Filmic: vivid's, with contrast. Neutral: Khronos PBR Neutral, colours as the art has them. Tony: Tony McMapface, soft and natural, the brightest going white as the eye sees them. Uncharted 2: John Hable's film curve from Uncharted 2, a long soft roll into white, bright colours paler.
chinese: 场景光照如何转为屏幕画面。Filmic:vivid 曲线，带对比。Neutral:Khronos PBR Neutral，颜色贴近美术原意。Tony:Tony McMapface，柔和自然，最亮处按人眼观感压向白色。Uncharted 2:《神秘海域2》的 John Hable 电影曲线，向白过渡长而柔，亮色偏淡。

english: How the turn grows as the stick goes over: 1 evenly, higher for finer aim near the centre and the full speed at the rim.
chinese: 摇杆推离中心时转向增益的变化:1 为均匀，数值越大中心附近越精细、边缘保持全速。

english: How thick each pixel is taken to be when it shades another: a share of the depth left before the far plane. Thicker joins more shadows and lets thin things cast thicker ones.
chinese: 像素给其它像素投影时被视为的厚度（以距远平面的深度比例计）。越厚，阴影越容易相连，细薄物体的投影也更厚。

english: How thick the ring's line is, however far off it lies, in pixels on a 1080p screen (more on a larger one), with a thin dark edge round it so it stands out on bright water.
chinese: 水环线条的粗细（不论远近，按 1080p 像素计，屏幕更大则更粗），外缘有一圈细暗边以便在亮水面上看清。

english: How well your eyes see in the dark once they are used to it: the dark lifted towards a dim grey, without its colour, sharpness or detail, which no setting brings back. Your eyes take time to get used to the dark, and a bright light undoes it. Cat's Eyes doubles it. 0: the night as black as its light.
chinese: 眼睛适应黑暗后的夜视能力:夜色被提亮为暗灰，但无颜色、锐度与细节，任何设置都无法恢复。适应需要时间，强光会打断。夜猫子特质使其翻倍。0 表示与光照一致的纯黑夜晚。

english: How wide a head lamp's beam spreads each side of its axis. The game's own lamps spread 41 degrees, the cone of its old square light.
chinese: 车头灯光束在轴线两侧的张开角度。游戏自带灯具张角为 41 度（旧版方形光照的锥形范围）。

english: How wide an arc is when fresh.
chinese: 刀光弧刚出现时的宽度。

english: How wide the lines are. They thin out with distance at any width.
chinese: 线条宽度。任何宽度都会随距离变细。

english: In a room from which no window or doorway in view reaches the outside, leaves out the whole distant world at once, before any of it is measured: the rooms' culling has the answer already. Off: each piece of it is left out on its own, or not at all.
chinese: 当可见的窗与门都看不到室外时，直接整体剔除远景世界，无需逐项测算:房间剔除已给出答案。关闭:逐块剔除或完全不剔除。

english: In a vehicle: how far above its usual height the camera stands (squares).
chinese: 载具内:相机相对常规高度的抬升（格）。

english: In a vehicle: how far behind it the camera stands. The vehicle keeps its size on the screen whatever the third-person field of view.
chinese: 载具内:相机在其后多远。无论第三人称视野如何，载具在屏幕上的大小不变。

english: In a vehicle: how far to the right of the middle the camera stands (squares; below 0, to the left).
chinese: 载具内:相机相对中线右偏多少（格；小于 0 为左偏）。

english: In first and third person, the game's sidebar at the screen's left: what the hands hold and its buttons. Off hides it whole; on shows the parts below that are on, moved up together. The isometric view always has the game's own.
chinese: 第一/第三人称下，屏幕左侧的游戏侧边栏:手持物品与各按钮。关闭则整体隐藏；开启则显示下方已启用的部分并上移合并。等距视角始终使用游戏原版。

english: In first and third person, the inventory key, Tab and the sidebar's bag and heart open Viewpoint's inventory screen and its character tabs. Off: the game's own inventory, loot and character windows, with the cursor freed for them, for a mod that changes those windows.
chinese: 第一/第三人称下，背包键、Tab 以及侧边栏的背包与心形图标会打开 Viewpoint 的背包界面及其角色标签页。关闭:改用游戏自带的背包、战利品与角色窗口并释放光标，适合会改这些窗口的模组。

english: In first and third person, what you aim at within reach is outlined and its items listed beside the crosshair. Off: the game's own loot window only.
chinese: 第一/第三人称下，把触及范围内瞄准的目标描边并在准星旁列出其物品。关闭:仅使用游戏自带的战利品窗口。

english: In first person, how far the view may turn each way from where the body faces while the free look's key is held. In third person the view goes all round.
chinese: 第一人称按住自由观察键时，视角相对身体朝向可转的角度。第三人称可绕全身。

english: In first person, the main thread's time a frame for taking the chunks the game has read into its world, which it otherwise takes several at once as the player walks into new ground: a long frame, which the world shows as a stop. A chunk not taken in yet is drawn by the far world.
chinese: 第一人称下，每帧在主线程把游戏已读取的区块并入世界的时间；否则玩家走入新区域时会一次并入多个区块，造成明显卡顿。尚未并入的区块由远景世界绘制。

english: In furniture mode, what the furniture tool needs to pick up, scrap or repair what you aim at: its tools, skill and parts, and what stops it. Off: the menu alone. The game's own furniture window, while its tool is out, stays as it is.
chinese: 家具模式下，家具工具拾取、拆解或修理目标所需:工具、技能、零件，以及受阻原因。关闭:只显示菜单。家具工具激活时游戏自带的家具窗口不受影响。

english: In the game's debug mode (-debug) only: a free camera the world is centred on; what is drawn, its detail and the sound follow it.
chinese: 仅在游戏调试模式 (-debug) 下:以自由相机为中心，绘制内容、细节与声音均随之移动。

english: In third person the character's head turns to where you look, standing and walking.
chinese: 第三人称下，站立与行走时角色头部会随你的视线转动。

english: In third person, draws the head look over the character and writes every pose's numbers into Zomboid/viewpoint-camera-traces, to find what turns the head wrong.
chinese: 第三人称下在角色身上绘制头部朝向，并把各姿势数值写入 Zomboid/viewpoint-camera-traces，用于排查头部转向异常。

english: In third person, raising the sights switches to first person and lowering them switches back. Hip fire stays in third person.
chinese: 第三人称下抬镜切到第一人称，放下切回。腰射仍保持第三人称。

english: Ink: a deep blue-black that keeps a little of the colour under it. Black: pure black lines.
chinese: 墨色:带一点底色的深蓝黑。黑色:纯黑线条。

english: Intel's ASSAO: Medium and High read a pixel in four at half the size each way, with 3 and 5 pairs of samples; Ultra every pixel with 5, Extreme every pixel with 12.
chinese: Intel ASSAO:中与高把像素按四分之一大小读取，分别取 3 与 5 对样本；超高每像素 5 个，极致每像素 12 个。

english: Iron sights, red dots, holo sights and other unmagnified sights. 1.0 = no zoom.
chinese: 机瞄、红点、全息等无放大瞄具。1.0 表示不放大。

english: Its angle at the end of its sweep: 90 upright, more leaning left (never off the glass).
chinese: 其扫掠终点角度:90 为竖直，数值更大则更偏左（不会超出玻璃）。

english: Its angle at the end of its sweep.
Keeps the clouds as soft as their resolution draws them, steadier as they move, rather than built up sharp over many frames.
chinese: 让云保持其分辨率下的柔软观感、移动时更稳定，而不是多帧累积后变得锐利。

english: Keeps Viewpoint's compiled shaders in the game's cache folder, so the next session loads them in place of compiling them again. A new graphics driver compiles them once more.
chinese: 把 Viewpoint 已编译的着色器保存在游戏缓存目录，下次启动直接加载而无需重编译。更换显卡驱动后会再编译一次。

english: Leaves out the distant land, its trees and the shell's blocks that the loaded world in front of them hides, which indoors is almost all of it. Off: only what falls outside the view is left out.
chinese: 剔除被前方已加载世界遮挡的远景陆地、树木与外壳方块（室内时几乎全部）。关闭:仅剔除视野之外的部分。

english: Leaves out the zombies, people and things that the loaded world in front of them hides, from some way off: nearer, one coming round a corner would show a frame late. Their shadows stay.
chinese: 剔除一定距离外被前方已加载世界遮挡的丧尸、人物与物体；距离过近时，从拐角出现会晚一帧。其阴影仍保留。

english: Lines drawn round shapes and along their creases, as a comic's inker draws them, fading into the haze with distance.
chinese: 沿形体轮廓与褶皱绘制的线条，如漫画上墨，随距离没入雾霭。

english: Low: fine beads of rain on the windows and the cars' glass. Medium: drops that cling, run down the glass, merge and wipe the beads off their way. High: lamps and torches shine in them, and rivulets run down the walls. Ultra and Extreme: more drops. True to size: from afar they are a faint wet sheen.
chinese: 低:窗与车窗上有细密水珠。中:水珠附着、顺玻璃流下、合并并擦去沿途水珠。高:灯光与手电在其上反光，墙上也有细水流。超高与极致:水滴更多。真实尺寸:远处表现为淡淡的湿润光泽。

english: Lower = snappier, higher = softer movement into and out of the compressed pose.
chinese: 越低越干脆，越高进入/离开压缩姿势越柔和。

english: Lowers the muzzle a little while you hold a firearm without aiming. Off by default.
chinese: 持枪未瞄准时略微压低枪口。默认关闭。

english: Makes the renderer, its shaders and the game's model shaders while the game loads a save, so the first switch to first or third person is quick. A bar at the bottom left shows the progress.
chinese: 读档时预先生成渲染器、着色器与游戏模型着色器，使首次切换第一/第三人称更快。左下角显示进度条。

english: Marks the ground round you that can be worked (a furrow dug, grass removed or scythed, dung raked, a grave dug, dirt taken), and the loot menu offers what can be done to the square aimed at.
chinese: 标出周围可作业的地面（挖沟、除草或割草、耙粪、挖坟、取土），拾取菜单也会列出对瞄准格子可执行的操作。

english: Models near the camera, or between it and your character, dissolve, so they never hide your character. Off keeps them solid: they can hide your character, and the camera can cut into them. Your own character still dissolves where the camera comes inside it.
chinese: 离相机近或挡在相机与角色之间的模型会溶解，避免遮住角色。关闭则保持实心:可能遮住角色，相机也可能切进模型内部。相机进入自身角色时该角色仍会溶解。

english: Moves the camera's near clip plane from 5 cm to about 1 cm while sights are up, so the receiver and stock right under your eye are drawn instead of being cut open.
chinese: 抬镜时把相机近裁剪面从 5 厘米移到约 1 厘米，使贴近眼睛的机匣与枪托正常绘制而不被剖开。

english: Moves the head lamps forward, out of the front, or below 0 back into it.
chinese: 车头灯向前移动；小于 0 则向后收。

english: Moves the head lamps out to the sides, or below 0 in towards the middle.
chinese: 车头灯向两侧移动；小于 0 则向中间靠。

english: Moves the head lamps up, or below 0 down.
chinese: 车头灯向上移动；小于 0 则向下。

english: Moves the loot menu down (more) or up (less) from its place beside the crosshair, as a share of the screen's height. It stays on the screen.
chinese: 把拾取菜单相对准星旁的位置下移（数值越大）或上移，按屏幕高度比例计，始终保持在屏内。

english: Moves the loot menu right (more) or left (less) from its place beside the crosshair, as a share of the screen's width. It stays on the screen.
chinese: 把拾取菜单相对准星旁的位置右移（数值越大）或左移，按屏幕宽度比例计，始终保持在屏内。

english: Moves the tail and brake lights back, out of the rear, or below 0 forward into it.
chinese: 尾灯与刹车灯向后移动；小于 0 则向前。

english: Moves the tail and brake lights out to the sides, or below 0 in towards the middle.
chinese: 尾灯与刹车灯向两侧移动；小于 0 则向中间靠。

english: Moves the tail and brake lights up, or below 0 down.
chinese: 尾灯与刹车灯向上移动；小于 0 则向下。

english: Multiplies every weapon's raise time (higher = faster).
chinese: 所有武器的抬枪时间倍率（越大越快）。

english: Multiplies the zoom of 2x/4x/8x scopes. 1.0 = the scope's own number against Viewpoint's wide view; 1.5 = a 4x scope zooms 6x.
chinese: 2/4/8 倍镜的倍率乘数。1.0 表示镜身标称值对应 Viewpoint 宽视野；1.5 表示 4 倍镜放大到 6 倍。

english: Nearer than this the far world's ground and walls have a colour for every square; further, one for every two squares, a quarter of the memory.
chinese: 在此距离内，远景地面与墙体每格一种颜色；更远处每两格一种，内存占四分之一。

english: Nearer, a zombie is posed by the game: its head turned, what it holds. Farther, its animations, each baked once, are blended on the graphics card as the game blends them, and the game does not work out its skeleton.
chinese: 较近时由游戏给丧尸摆姿势（转头、手持物）。更远时，各动画烘焙一次后在显卡上按游戏方式混合，游戏不再计算其骨骼。

english: Off grows a candidate blade for every place round you and throws away the ones the view cannot reach; on dispatches only the ground the view does reach. The picture is the same either way: this is for measuring what the dispatch costs.
chinese: 关闭时会为你周围的每个位置生成候选草叶再丢弃视野外的；开启时只派发视野能到达的地面。两种方式画面相同，此项用于测量派发开销。

english: On, a corpse is considered for a 3D model only while it lies on screen (with a small margin): any other keeps its picture with nothing done for it each frame, and one posed lately takes its pose back as it comes into view. Off, to compare: every corpse within the distance, all round the player.
chinese: 开启时，只有尸体在屏内（含少量余量）才考虑使用 3D 模型:其余尸体保持平面图，每帧不做任何处理，刚摆过姿势的进入视野时恢复姿势。关闭用于对比:玩家周围该距离内所有尸体都参与。

english: On: the lines fade into the fog and haze with the land. Off: they keep their strength through it.
chinese: 开启:线条随景物一同没入雾霭。关闭:线条保持强度穿透雾气。

english: Opens the inventory screen on what the loot menu shows, with the cursor free; again to close it.
chinese: 按拾取菜单所指向的内容打开背包界面并释放光标；再按一次关闭。

english: Other players' guns also give way at walls, doors and furniture on your screen. Worked out on your own game from what it already knows about them (no network traffic, nothing needed on the server); players who run this mod see yours the same way. Up to 12 nearest aiming players within 40 tiles.
chinese: 你屏幕上其他玩家的枪也会在墙、门与家具处让步。完全由本机依据已有信息计算（无网络流量，服务端无需支持）；装了本模组的玩家也会同样看到你的枪。最多处理 40 格内最近的 12 名瞄准中的玩家。

english: Outlines whatever the loot menu aims at: objects, the ground's items, bodies, vehicles, animals and players. Off: no outline; the menu still lists them. Ground mode has a switch of its own.
chinese: 给拾取菜单瞄准的目标描边:物体、地面物品、尸体、载具、动物与玩家。关闭则不描边，菜单仍会列出。地面模式有独立开关。

english: Over the windscreen as measured (outlined orange): each wiper's swept glass tinted (the left one blue, the right one orange), its blade outlined parked and at its sweep's end, the arc its tip draws and its pivot marked.
chinese: 按实测挡风玻璃叠加显示（橙色描边）:各雨刷扫过的区域着色（左蓝右橙），刷片在停放位与扫掠终点描边，并标出刷尖轨迹弧与支点。

english: Playing alone, a pad's button or stick makes it the player's, and a key or the mouse gives the player back to the keyboard and mouse. Turn it off for split-screen with the keyboard: a second pad's press then joins as the game's.
chinese: 单人游玩时，按手柄任意键或摇杆即切换为该玩家，按键鼠标则切回键鼠。用键盘分屏时请关闭:否则按第二个手柄会被游戏当作加入分屏。

english: Pushing the right stick up looks down, and down looks up.
chinese: 右摇杆上推改为向下看，下推改为向上看。

english: Puts each vehicle's lamps on the glass its own model lights for them (found once for each kind of vehicle); off, every lamp stands on the vehicle's box, moved by the sliders below.
chinese: 把每辆车的车灯放在其模型自带的灯罩玻璃上（每种车型只探测一次）；关闭则所有灯都挂在车体包围盒上，由下方滑块调整位置。

english: Puts the item selected down where you aim, as the game's Place Item does: one on the ground is moved there without taking it first.
chinese: 把选中的物品放到瞄准处，等同于游戏的「放置物品」:地上的物品可直接移动，无需先拾取。

english: Realistic: blades that bend, fall over at their tops and catch the light as real grass. Painted: tufts of the game's own grass art, which sway the same way and soften into the distance where a blade thinner than a pixel flickers.
chinese: 真实:草叶会弯折、顶端下垂并按真实草叶受光。手绘:使用游戏自带草丛贴图，摆动方式相同，并在远处柔化以避免亚像素草叶闪烁。

english: Rest the gun's handguard on a table, counter, low wall, fence or window sill with the sights up, or go prone (Viewpoint Advanced Movement), and the sway settles; with a deployed bipod it all but stops and the recoil is halved. Needs 'Physical weapon collision' on for surfaces.
chinese: 抬镜时把护木搭在桌、台面、矮墙、栏杆或窗台上，或趴下（需 Viewpoint Advanced Movement），晃动会稳定下来；展开两脚架后几乎不晃且后坐减半。需要开启「武器物理碰撞」才能架在物体上。

english: Rolls the loot of the containers a chunk loads with over the next frames, nearest first, not all in the frame it loads: no hitch as you walk or drive into a town. Single player only.
chinese: 区块加载时容器内的战利品在随后几帧内逐步生成（由近及远），而不是全挤在加载那一帧:走入或驱车进入城镇不再卡顿。仅单人有效。

english: Scales the view climb and the visible gun kick. Above 0, Viewpoint's own camera recoil and weapon recoil are replaced by this mod's.
chinese: 缩放视角上抬与可见的枪械后坐。大于 0 时，Viewpoint 自带的相机后坐与武器后坐由本模组替代。

english: Scopes of 4x and up zoom in steps: an 8x goes 2x / 4x / 8x, a 6x 1.5x / 3x / 6x, a 4x 2x / 4x. Optics registered with their own zoom levels always use them.
chinese: 4 倍及以上倍镜按档位变倍:8 倍为 2/4/8，6 倍为 1.5/3/6，4 倍为 2/4。自带变倍档位的瞄具始终使用自身档位。

english: Scopes show their magnified view inside the scope's glass, and red dots / holo sights show the world clearly through their window with the lit reticle, while the rest of the screen, the gun and your hands stay normal. Renders the world a second time while aiming through an optic, so it costs some frame rate. Off: magnified scopes magnify the whole first-person view behind a lens mask. If it ever fails it switches itself off and the classic view is used.
chinese: 倍镜的放大画面显示在镜片内，红点/全息瞄具透过窗口呈现清晰世界与发光准星，屏幕其余部分、枪身与双手保持正常。开镜时会把世界再渲染一次，因此会损失部分帧率。关闭:倍镜放大整个第一人称画面并加镜片遮罩。若运行出错会自动关闭并回退经典模式。

english: Seated in a vehicle on a slope, how the first-person view turns with it: its pitch and roll, as a head in the car turns; its pitch alone, the horizon kept level across; or not at all.
chinese: 在斜坡上的载具内，第一人称视角如何随车倾斜:同时俯仰与侧倾（如车内人头），仅俯仰（保持水平线），或完全不随动。

english: Separation asks, for each square holding a character next to another, whether a wall, window, door or stairs stands between them; the answers are kept until the game says a chunk around them changed.
chinese: 分离判定会询问相邻角色所在格之间是否有墙、窗、门或楼梯；结果会缓存，直到游戏报告周围区块发生变化。

english: Shots from the hip go somewhere inside a cone that depends on the weapon (wide for snipers and machine guns, tight for pistols), grows while moving or running and shrinks with Aiming skill. Aim down the sights to hit at range. Works with Viewpoint True Ballistics. Not added while Viewpoint's own 'Gunplay Rework (0.1.6)' setting is on: its aim ring already spreads hip fire.
chinese: 腰射的弹道落在一个与武器相关的锥形范围内（狙击与机枪大、手枪小），移动或奔跑时变大，随瞄准技能提升而收小。远距离请开镜。可与 Viewpoint True Ballistics 配合。若已开启 Viewpoint 的「枪械手感重做 (0.1.6)」，此项不再叠加（其准星环已包含腰射散布）。

english: Shows the dot that marks where you look and aim. The game's Hide all UI also hides it.
chinese: 显示标记视线与瞄准位置的中心点。游戏的「隐藏全部 UI」也会隐藏它。

english: Shows the mouse's controls as keys at the screen's bottom left, the most used first (drag, Ctrl+click, double-click and the rest), and every one of them on hovering its ?. Off: that corner is left empty. A controller's button prompts show either way.
chinese: 在屏幕左下角以按键形式提示鼠标操作，最常用的在前（拖动、Ctrl+点击、双击等），悬停在问号上可看全部。关闭:该角落留空。手柄按键提示不受影响。

english: Shows the ring round the screen's middle. The crosshair moves only inside this ring, and a smaller ring is a more accurate shot. Off, only the crosshair shows.
chinese: 显示屏幕中央的环。准星只在该环内游走，环越小射击越准。关闭:只显示准星。

english: Shows the weapon's measured length, its rear, pivot and muzzle, the probe hit, the obstruction amount and the pose on screen, and logs state changes.
chinese: 显示武器实测长度、后端、支点、枪口、探测命中点、受阻程度与屏幕上的姿势，并记录状态变化。

english: Shows your character's 3D model on the Character tab. Off saves drawing it; dropping clothes in its place still wears them.
chinese: 在角色标签页显示你的 3D 模型。关闭可省去绘制；把衣服拖到原位置仍然会穿上。

english: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA T2x: SMAA over two frames drawn a quarter of a pixel apart, sharp and steady. TAA+: each frame blended with the ones before, the steadiest and the softest. TAA: the same over fewer frames. TAA + FXAA: TAA over frames FXAA has smoothed. SMAA, FXAA: each frame on its own, edges can still shimmer. Off: none. Off while resolution scaling is on: its upscaler smooths the edges.
chinese: 平滑锯齿边缘。SMAA T2x:在两帧间偏移四分之一像素做 SMAA，锐利且稳定。TAA+:每帧与之前若干帧混合，最稳最柔。TAA:相同但参考帧更少。TAA + FXAA:在 FXAA 处理过的帧上做 TAA。SMAA、FXAA:仅单帧处理，边缘仍可能闪烁。关闭:不处理。分辨率缩放开启时若关闭，则由升采样器负责平滑。

english: Smooths jagged edges. TAA+: each frame blended with the ones before, the steadiest and smoothest. TAA: the same over fewer frames. TAA + FXAA: TAA over frames FXAA has smoothed. SMAA T2x: SMAA over two frames drawn a quarter of a pixel apart, sharp and steadier than SMAA for little more. SMAA, FXAA: each frame on its own, sharp, edges can still shimmer. Off: none. Off while resolution scaling is on: its upscaler smooths the edges.
chinese: 平滑锯齿边缘。TAA+:每帧与之前若干帧混合，最稳最平滑。TAA:相同但参考帧更少。TAA + FXAA:在 FXAA 处理过的帧上做 TAA。SMAA T2x:两帧间偏移四分之一像素的 SMAA，比 SMAA 更锐更稳且代价略高。SMAA、FXAA:单帧处理，锐利但边缘仍可能闪烁。关闭:不处理。分辨率缩放开启时若关闭，由升采样器负责平滑。

english: Smooths jagged edges. TAA+: each frame blended with the ones before, the steadiest and smoothest. TAA: the same over fewer frames. TAA + FXAA: TAA over frames FXAA has smoothed. SMAA, FXAA: each frame on its own, sharp, edges can still shimmer. Off: none.
chinese: 平滑锯齿边缘。TAA+:每帧与之前若干帧混合，最稳最平滑。TAA:相同但参考帧更少。TAA + FXAA:在 FXAA 处理过的帧上做 TAA。SMAA、FXAA:单帧处理，锐利但边缘仍可能闪烁。关闭:不处理。

english: Soft ghosts, a faint halo and a glow where the sun or the moon shines into the view, as a coated film lens makes them.
chinese: 日月直射镜头时的柔和鬼影、淡淡光晕与辉光，如同镀膜镜头产生的效果。

english: Squares the real ground is smoothed over before anything is built on it, away from towns: the hills keep their shape.
chinese: 城镇之外，真实地面在建造前被平滑的格数:越大山丘越圆缓。

english: Steps the game's furniture tool through the loot menu: pick up, place, rotate, disassemble, repair, then off. The loot menu offers that one thing for the furniture aimed at; in place mode, aimed at the floor, what you carry to put down.
chinese: 通过拾取菜单切换游戏的家具工具:拾取、放置、旋转、拆解、修理、关闭。瞄准家具时菜单只提供对应操作；放置模式下瞄准地面则放置携带的物品。

english: Storm clouds darken and drain the sky; the worst storms take on a greenish cast.
chinese: 风暴云让天空变暗褪色；最强的风暴会带一点绿色。

english: The 3D grass's blades cast these shadows on one another and the ground, and take them from everything else; off, the grass neither casts nor takes them, and the ambient occlusion and the sun's shadow maps shade it.
chinese: 3D 草叶之间以及在地面上互相投影，也接收其它物体的阴影；关闭则草既不投影也不接收，改由环境光遮蔽与太阳阴影贴图表现。

english: The blades a square near you against the quality's.
chinese: 你附近每格的草叶数（相对画质档）。

english: The blades' height against the grass's own: a town's lawn, the wild grass, all together.
chinese: 草叶高度（相对草自身）:城镇草坪与野外高草统一生效。

english: The blades' width against their own.
The camera moves to the other shoulder when a wall is in the way, and back when it clears. Never while aiming.
chinese: 有墙挡住时相机自动换肩，让开后换回。瞄准时不会换。

english: The camera starts and ends the switch far back with this narrow field of view, standing in for the game's flat isometric picture: the narrower, the flatter, and the further back.
chinese: 切换开始与结束时相机在远处、以此窄视野等效游戏的平面等距画面:越窄越平、相机越远。

english: The chance a blade's pass, up or down, leaves any arcs: each pass leaves its own, in places of its own.
chinese: 每次挥击（上或下）留下刀光弧的概率:每一下各自独立。

english: The chance a second, at full rain, that a free drop lands somewhere on the glass.
chinese: 满雨量时每秒有水滴落在玻璃上的概率。

english: The clouds above the low ones, as Horizon Forbidden West draws them: cirrus and veils high up, altocumulus lower, each drifting on the wind at its height. Textured: from images. Procedural: from the clouds' noise.
chinese: 低云之上的高层云，参照《地平线:西之绝境》:高空卷云与薄纱，较低的为高积云，各自按所在高度的风向飘移。贴图:使用图像。程序化:使用云的噪声生成。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Ammunition). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（弹药）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Books and maps). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（书籍与地图）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Equipment). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（装备）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Food and drink). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（食物与饮料）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Materials). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（材料）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Medical). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（医疗）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Tools). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（工具）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour tiles of this type take (Weapons). None leaves them plain.
chinese: 该类物品格子使用的颜色（武器）。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The colour your junk's tiles take (Junk items, below), whatever kind of thing each is. None leaves them plain.
chinese: 杂物格子使用的颜色（见下方「杂物」），无论其种类。选「无」则保持原样。

english: The darkest tones raised, which washes the image as old film stock does. 0 keeps the blacks black.
chinese: 提高最暗调，使画面像老胶片一样发灰。0 保持纯黑。

english: The fine beads' size on the windscreen against the other glass's.
chinese: 挡风玻璃上细水珠的大小（相对其它玻璃）。

english: The flowers, weeds and leaves the game lays flat on the ground, and the vines on its walls, cast and take these shadows as if they stood up from it (Tuning's relief heights); off, they lie flat in it.
chinese: 游戏平铺在地面的花草与墙上的藤蔓，按立起的高度投影与受影（参看「地形起伏」的高度设置）；关闭则维持平贴。

english: The game updates its world a fixed number of times a second, set below, instead of once a frame, and the main thread rests between updates. Single player, in first person only.
chinese: 游戏每秒以固定次数更新世界（次数见下方），而非每帧一次，主线程在更新间隙休息。仅单人、第一人称有效。

english: The game's art is drawn for its isometric view, where a level line falls a pixel every two. Up close on a wall, a door frame or a door, those steps showed as teeth; this reads the art upright so the lines run straight.
chinese: 游戏美术按等距视角绘制（水平线每两像素下降一像素）。贴近墙面、门框或门时那些台阶会呈锯齿；此项按直立方式解析美术，使线条笔直。

english: The game's designated zones, for animals among others.
chinese: 游戏标定的区域（动物等）。

english: The ground has the relief and the shine of what it is made of: grass and soil rough and uneven, asphalt with its stones, tiles glazed between their grout lines, wood smooth. Off: every floor is flat and equally rough.
chinese: 地面按其材质呈现起伏与光泽:草地与泥土粗糙不平，沥青有碎石，地砖在缝间有釉光，木板平滑。关闭则所有地面同样平整粗糙。

english: The ground rising and falling as the real Kentucky does, the hills on the horizon where they stand.
chinese: 地面如真实肯塔基般起伏，地平线上的山丘也各就其位。

english: The heap the game's memory manager collects to stay within, under the game's own cap: less of the computer's memory held, more collecting when the game's use comes near it. Auto takes a quarter of the computer's memory, at least 4 GiB, and none where that is not under the game's cap. Read when the game starts.
chinese: 游戏内存管理器回收以维持的堆上限（低于游戏自身上限）:占用更少内存，接近上限时回收更频繁。自动取内存的四分之一（至少 4 GiB），若低于游戏上限则不设。启动时读取。

english: The items you count as junk, by name, with a comma between two (Receipt, Sheet of Paper; any case): every item of that name, worn, bloody, empty or renamed alike, whatever mod it comes from; berries and mushrooms by the name you know them by. An item's right-click menu on the screen adds it or takes it off. A name no item has stays, named under the box. A column's Filter lists them under Junk, and only there. It starts with what the game files under its own Junk category (cigarettes, receipts, tin cans and the like): take off what you use. Apart from the game's own Set Unwanted.
chinese: 按名称定义你视为杂物的物品，两个名称之间用逗号（如 Receipt, Sheet of Paper；不区分大小写）:同名的物品，不论磨损、血迹、空置或被改名，也不论来自哪个模组；浆果与蘑菇按你熟悉的名称。在界面中右键物品可加入或移出。没有物品使用的名称会保留并显示在框下。各列的「筛选」会把它们仅列在「杂物」下。初始包含游戏自身归类为杂物的物品（香烟、收据、罐头等）:把你用的移出去。与游戏自带的「设为不要」功能相互独立。

english: The largest a drop grows by joining others: drops that would pass it lie together unjoined, drawn as one body of water, and keep their water.
chinese: 水滴合并生长的上限:超过该尺寸的水滴彼此相邻但不合并，仅绘制成一整片水且各自保留水量。

english: The least radius a drop lands at.
The left wiper's angle parked, from the windscreen's foot (the blade points right).
chinese: 左雨刷停放角度（以挡风下沿为基准，刷片朝右）。

english: The light the lit floors round about bounce onto walls, ceilings and things, and the light the flashlight's beam bounces back from where it lands.
chinese: 周围受光地面反弹到墙壁、天花板与物体上的光，以及手电光束在其落点反弹回来的光。

english: The line's tension gauge while the line is out, in first and third person and in the game's own view. Hidden, the tension works as before: the line breaks past the red, and a fish gets away when the line is too slack.
chinese: 放线时显示鱼线张力表（第一/第三人称及游戏原视角）。隐藏后张力机制照常:超过红区断线，线太松鱼会跑掉。

english: The most radius a drop lands at (they land at any size between, evenly).
chinese: 水滴落下的最大半径（其间的尺寸均匀分布）。

english: The most the shader programs kept on disk take: past it, the oldest are deleted.
chinese: 磁盘上着色器程序的占用上限:超出后删除最旧的。

english: The number of sounds that you hear at the same time: Lower is 64, as in the game without Viewpoint, Normal is 128, Higher is 256. When more sounds play, the quietest sounds stop until other sounds end. At Lower, sounds near you can stop suddenly in a large horde. Higher uses more processor time for sound. Takes effect when the game starts next.
chinese: 同时听到的声音数量:低为 64（等同未装 Viewpoint），中为 128，高为 256。超出时最轻的声音会被中断直到其它声音结束。低档时在尸潮中近处声音可能突然中断。高档次之耗更多处理器时间。下次启动游戏生效。

english: The picture's colour follows the weather: cool and grey in storms, golden when the sun comes out over wet ground, blue on rainy nights.
chinese: 画面颜色随天气变化:风暴中冷灰，雨后放晴泛金，雨夜偏蓝。

english: The port it answers on: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/
The profiler (Debug, Profiling): over half the screen, over all of it, off.
chinese: 性能分析面板（调试 → 性能分析）:覆盖半屏、全屏、关闭。

english: The red and the blue of the image pulled apart towards the edges of the screen, as a lens that does not focus every colour at one place.
chinese: 画面边缘红蓝通道分离，如同未能把各色聚焦于一点的镜头。

english: The render thread draws frames of its own while the game works out its next step: the world between the game's last two steps, the view at the newest mouse. Off, one frame a step.
chinese: 游戏计算下一步时渲染线程自行绘制帧:世界位于游戏最近两步之间，视角取最新鼠标位置。关闭则每步一帧。

english: The ring's colour within the game's reach. Past it the ring is always red.
chinese: 游戏射程内的环颜色。超出射程后环恒为红色。

english: The same in towns, where much of the ground about is built on: gentler ground under the streets and houses, blended to the open's at a town's edge.
chinese: 城镇内的同类设置（城镇大部分地面有建筑）:街道与房屋下方地形更平缓，在城镇边缘过渡到野外地形。

english: The same while aiming: the camera moves between the two as aiming starts and ends.
chinese: 瞄准时同理:相机在开始与结束瞄准时于两者间过渡。

english: The screen comes back even when the use stops before it is done: you ran, were hit or cancelled it. Off: it comes back only after a use you finished, so the view stays yours when you have to move.
chinese: 中途打断使用（跑动、受击、取消）后界面也会返回。关闭:只有完成使用后才返回，便于你在需要移动时保持视角自由。

english: The server sends what changes on every square round a player, and the game drops a change to a square it has not taken in yet: an item another player drops there is missing until the chunk loads again. A chunk that has waited this long is taken in at once (0: always at the game's pace).
chinese: 服务端会发送玩家周围各格的改动，而游戏会丢弃尚未并入区块的改动:别人放在那里的物品要等区块重新加载才出现。等待超过该时长的区块会立即并入（0 表示始终按游戏节奏）。

english: The shade in corners, in creases and under things, where less of the light from all round reaches (XeGTAO's ground-truth occlusion).
chinese: 角落、褶皱与物体下方的阴影（四周光照到达较少处），采用 XeGTAO 的基准遮蔽。

english: The shade in corners, in creases and under things, where less of the light from all round reaches.
chinese: 角落、褶皱与物体下方的阴影（四周光照到达较少处）。

english: The share of the fine beads the windscreen holds against the other glass. The blades clear them but do not drag them, as they drag the drops.
chinese: 挡风玻璃上细水珠的数量占比（相对其它玻璃）。雨刷会刮掉它们但不像大水珠那样拖动它们。

english: The share of the lanes across a blade (4 mm each) that leave an arc behind it, on a pass that leaves any.
chinese: 一次留下刀光弧的挥击中，刀刃上（每段 4 毫米）产生弧线的比例。

english: The share of the lanes across the air's way that hold a rivulet at full speed.
chinese: 气流通道中维持满速细水流的比例。

english: The simulated raindrops on glass by how they move: grey while held, coloured while they run, their colour the way they go on the screen (down blue, up yellow, left green, right magenta) and their brightness their speed. The windscreen the wipers sweep is outlined in orange.
chinese: 按运动状态显示玻璃上的模拟雨滴:静止为灰色，流动时着色，颜色表示屏幕上的流向（下蓝、上黄、左绿、右品红），亮度表示速度。雨刷扫过的挡风玻璃区域为橙色描边。

english: The size the world is drawn at against the screen's. Under 100%: fewer pixels, faster. With TAA, the samples of many frames make the image at the screen's size; without it, FSR 1 brings the image up to the screen and sharpens it; with resolution scaling on, its upscaler does. Over 100%: supersampling, every edge smoothed by four samples a pixel at 200%, at four times the cost.
chinese: 世界绘制分辨率相对屏幕的比例。低于 100%:像素更少、更快。开启 TAA 时由多帧采样重建到屏幕分辨率；未开 TAA 时由 FSR 1 放大并锐化；开启分辨率缩放时由对应的升采样器处理。高于 100%:超采样，200% 时每像素四个样本，代价约四倍。

english: The small shadows the sun's shadow maps are too coarse for, traced over the screen towards the sun: under a chair, a can on a table, a car's tyres on the road. What is off the screen casts none.
chinese: 太阳阴影贴图过粗而丢失的小阴影，沿屏幕朝太阳方向追踪:椅下、桌上罐头、路面上的轮胎印。屏幕之外的不投影。

english: The snow that lies on the ground and on roofs, a layer with its own depth that you and cars leave tracks in. It becomes deeper while it snows. Off: the game's own snow tiles. Each level above Low gives sharper tracks and a finer surface.
chinese: 覆盖地面与屋顶的积雪，具有真实厚度，你与车辆会留下印迹，下雪时逐渐加深。关闭:使用游戏自带的雪地地块。高于「低」的每档印迹更清晰、表面更细腻。

english: The snow that lies on the ground and on roofs. It becomes deeper while it snows. Off: the game's own snow tiles. Low: plain snow. Medium: snow with rough edges, a rough surface and crystals that sparkle in the sun. High: sharper tracks that stay when you walk away. Ultra: the finest snow surface.
chinese: 覆盖地面与屋顶的积雪，下雪时逐渐加深。关闭:使用游戏自带的雪地地块。低:普通积雪。中:边缘粗糙、表面起伏，晶体会在阳光下闪。高:印迹更清晰且离开后保留。超高:最细腻的雪面。

english: The steepest a town's ground lies, so its houses' flat foundations meet with banks rather than cliffs; steeper as the town thins out, and no limit in the open.
chinese: 城镇地面的最大坡度，使房屋的平地基以缓坡而非断崖衔接；城镇边缘可更陡，野外不限。

english: The sun rises exactly at the game's dawn and sets at its dusk, on its real path across the sky. Off: Viewpoint's own sun for the date and latitude.
chinese: 太阳在游戏黎明升起、黄昏落下，并沿真实天空轨迹运行。关闭:使用 Viewpoint 按日期与纬度计算的太阳。

english: The tab the screen shows as it opens: the character, or the one shown when it last closed.
chinese: 界面打开时显示的标签页:角色页，或上次关闭时的标签页。

english: The view turns with the mouse as it is when the frame is drawn, not as it was a frame before: less lag, most when the game holds the frame rate back.
chinese: 视角使用绘制该帧时的鼠标位置而非上一帧，延迟更低，在游戏限帧时尤为明显。

english: The walls have the relief and the shine of what they are made of: brick and stone rough between their mortar lines, siding in its boards, a bathroom's tiles glazed, a garage door's metal smooth. Off: every wall is flat and equally rough.
chinese: 墙面按其材质呈现起伏与光泽:砖石在灰缝间起伏，壁板有板缝，浴室瓷砖有釉光，车库门金属平滑。关闭则所有墙面平整且粗糙度相同。

english: The whole image towards green or towards magenta, the other half of a camera's white balance.
chinese: 整幅画面偏绿或偏品红，这是相机白平衡的另一个分量。

english: The whole image towards orange or towards blue, as a camera's white balance does it.
chinese: 整幅画面偏橙或偏蓝，如同相机白平衡。

english: The wipers on the windscreen of the car you are in: they sweep while its engine runs in the rain, more often as it rains harder, and carry the water off the glass before them.
chinese: 你所乘车子的挡风玻璃雨刷:雨天引擎运转时间歇摆动，雨越大越频繁，并把前方的水刮走。

english: Their length against their own (9 to 24 cm).
chinese: 其长度（自身基准 9 至 24 厘米）。

english: Threads beside the main thread that share the simulation's ported work each tick (the zombies' skeletons). 0 leaves it all on the main thread.
chinese: 除主线程外参与分担模拟移植工作（丧尸骨骼）的线程数。0 表示全部留在主线程。

english: Trees and bushes between you and the sun glow yellow-green with the light passing through them.
chinese: 你与太阳之间的树木和灌木被透射光照成黄绿色。

english: Turn to move: the body turns to where it walks, as with a controller, and backpedals facing the view when you walk backwards. Strafe: the body always faces the view, and walks sideways and backwards on the game's strafe steps, at the Backpedal speed.
chinese: 转向移动:身体朝行走方向转身（同手柄），后退时面朝视角倒退。横移:身体始终面朝视角，按游戏横移动作侧移与后退，速度取「倒退速度」。

english: Up to what radius a drop grows from the fine rain falling round it.
chinese: 水滴从周围细雨中增长的半径上限。

english: Uses the item selected as the game's inventory does: eats or drinks it, applies a bandage, wears it or takes it in hand. The menu's line says which, and the key shows only where it does something.
chinese: 按游戏背包的方式使用选中物品:吃喝、包扎、穿戴或拿在手上。菜单会注明具体动作，仅在有效时显示该键。

english: Vanilla: the plain look, quick on any GPU. Modern: the shader pack below.
chinese: 原版:朴素观感，任何显卡都快。现代:使用下方所选光影包。

english: Vicinity and the inventory are only as tall as what they list, and grow with it. Off: they always reach the bottom of the screen.
chinese: 周围与背包窗口的高度随内容伸缩。关闭:始终延伸到屏幕底部。

english: Viewpoint plays the game's sound, voice chat included, at 48 kHz in the output that you select here, with 3D sound and more sounds at the same time. When it is off, the game plays its own sound (32 kHz in 5.1), and the other settings here have no effect. Takes effect when the game starts next.
chinese: Viewpoint 以 48 kHz 在你选定的输出设备上播放游戏声音（含语音），支持 3D 音效与更多同时发声。关闭时由游戏自行播放（32 kHz、5.1），此处其它设置无效。下次启动游戏生效。

english: Viewpoint shader packs with depth of field focus on the screen centre, which is your sights when ADS, so the world blurs. This keeps the view sharp while sights are up.
chinese: 带景深效果的 Viewpoint 光影包会对焦屏幕中心（开镜时即瞄具位置），导致世界模糊。此项在抬镜时保持画面清晰。

english: Viewpoint's own FMOD mixes in stereo at the latency chosen into a WAV file in Zomboid/viewpoint-captures, as it plays, instead of to the speakers: the mix as it leaves FMOD, for measuring. Read when the game starts.
chinese: Viewpoint 自带的 FMOD 会以所选延迟把立体声混音写入 Zomboid/viewpoint-captures 下的 WAV 文件而不送扬声器:即 FMOD 输出的原始混音，供测量用。启动时读取。

english: Volumetric clouds in the sky, lit by the sun or the moon, shading the ground as they pass over it.
chinese: 天空中的体积云，受日月照亮，飘过时在地面投下阴影。

english: Walls out in the rain darken in uneven, running streaks, more of them the wetter it is.
chinese: 雨中的墙面呈现不规则的流痕变暗，越湿痕迹越多。

english: Water, puddles and car paint show what is around them. Off: they show only the sky. Medium: from one pixel in sixteen. High: from one pixel in four. Ultra: from the same pixels, further along each ray. Extreme: from every pixel.
chinese: 水面、水洼与车漆映出周围景物。关闭:只映天空。中:每十六像素取一。高:每四像素取一。超高:取同样像素但射线更长。极致:逐像素。

english: Water, puddles, car paint and polished floors show what is around them, traced over the screen. Off: they show only the sky. Low traces a quarter of the screen each way, Medium half; either costs the graphics card's time every frame, reflective or not.
chinese: 水面、水洼、车漆与抛光地面映出周围景物，沿屏幕追踪。关闭:只映天空。低为每向四分之一屏、中为一半；无论是否有反射都每帧消耗显卡时间。

english: What the far world builds from the map's files, kept in the game's cache folder for each save and map and read back next time: the far world comes in seconds after a load, not half a minute.
chinese: 远景世界从地图文件构建的结果，按存档与地图缓存在游戏目录，下次直接读回:读档后数秒即可呈现远景，而非等半分钟。

english: What the flashlight's beam falls on casts a shadow (a shadow map of its own). When a gun fires, what stands near it casts a shadow from the muzzle flash (six shadow maps, only while the flash shows).
chinese: 手电光束照到的物体投射阴影（独立阴影贴图）。枪械开火时，附近物体被枪口闪光投出阴影（6 张阴影贴图，仅在闪光出现期间）。

english: When a step runs more than one tick: whether Lua's key, mouse and UI events fire once a step, as the game fires them, or before every tick.
chinese: 一个步长执行多个 tick 时:Lua 的按键、鼠标与界面事件是按游戏方式每步触发一次，还是每个 tick 前触发。

english: Where the game's sound goes. Headphones mix it for two ears; the speakers' choices place it round you; Windows Sonic or Dolby Atmos hands it to Windows' spatial sound, which must be on in Windows' sound settings. Takes effect when the game starts next.
chinese: 游戏声音的输出位置。耳机按双耳混音；音箱选项把声音置于四周；Windows Sonic 或 Dolby Atmos 交给 Windows 空间音效（需在系统声音设置中开启）。下次启动游戏生效。

english: Where the head lamps' beams end, against the game's own reach (36 squares for a new lamp).
chinese: 车头灯光柱的终止距离（游戏新灯基准为 36 格）。

english: Where the left wiper pivots under the windscreen's foot: a share of its width from its middle, to the right.
chinese: 左雨刷支点位置（以挡风下沿计，从中线向右的比例）。

english: Where the right wiper pivots, the same way.
chinese: 右雨刷支点位置，含义同上。

english: Whether the rivulets the air drives at speed run on the windscreen too, or only on the other windows.
chinese: 气流高速吹出的细水流是否也出现在挡风玻璃上，还是仅在其它玻璃上。

english: Whether the view is behind the shoulder or at the eyes on foot. The key that switches the camera sets it, and a vehicle keeps a choice of its own.
chinese: 步行时视角位于肩后还是眼位。切换相机的按键会改变此项，载具另有独立选择。

english: Whether the view is behind the vehicle or at the eyes while seated in one. The key that switches the camera sets it while seated.
chinese: 乘坐载具时视角位于车后还是眼位。乘坐时按切换相机键即可改变。

english: Whether they run on the rear window too.
Which shoulder the camera looks over. The shoulder key swaps it while playing.
chinese: 相机过哪一侧肩。游戏中按换肩键切换。

english: While ground mode is on, outlines what you aim at, whatever the switch above says. Its squares' marks show either way.
chinese: 地面模式开启时，无论上方开关如何都会描边瞄准目标；其格子标记始终显示。

english: While looking through a variable scope: wheel up zooms in, wheel down zooms out.
chinese: 使用可变倍镜时:滚轮上滚放大，下滚缩小。

english: While the isometric view shows, keeps building what first and third person draw round you, a little each frame, so switching finds the world built. Costs the isometric view about a millisecond a frame while it builds.
chinese: 等距视角下持续构建第一/第三人称所需的周围世界，每帧一点，切换时即已就绪。构建期间等距视角每帧约多耗一毫秒。

english: While the loot menu shows a floor or a surface to put the item held on: puts it there. None by default: every button is the game's otherwise. The game does not see the press then.
chinese: 当拾取菜单显示可放置手持物品的地面或台面时:把物品放在那里。默认为「无」，否则所有按键归游戏。此时游戏不会收到该按键。

english: While the loot menu shows an item: uses or equips it, as a double-click in the game's inventory does. None by default: every button is the game's otherwise. The game does not see the press then.
chinese: 当拾取菜单显示物品时:使用或装备它，等同在游戏背包中双击。默认为「无」，否则按键归游戏。此时游戏不会收到该按键。

english: While the loot menu shows: opens the inventory screen on it, or the game's loot window with Viewpoint UI off, the pad in it (Y closes either). The game does not see the press then.
chinese: 拾取菜单显示时:在其上打开背包界面；Viewpoint 界面关闭时打开游戏战利品窗口（手柄为 Y 关闭）。此时游戏不会收到该按键。

english: While the loot menu shows: selects the row above, as the mouse wheel does; held, it steps on.
chinese: 拾取菜单显示时:选择上一行，等同滚轮；按住会连续移动。

english: While the loot menu shows: selects the row below, as the mouse wheel does; held, it steps on.
chinese: 拾取菜单显示时:选择下一行，等同滚轮；按住会连续移动。

english: While the loot menu shows: takes everything it lists. The game does not see the press then.
chinese: 拾取菜单显示时:拿取所列全部物品。此时游戏不会收到该按键。

english: While the loot menu shows: takes the item selected, or does the action selected. The game does not see the press then.
chinese: 拾取菜单显示时:拿取选中物品或执行选中动作。此时游戏不会收到该按键。

english: While the player moves, the chunks the game has read in a cone this wide either side of where it heads are taken in before the others, the nearest first; those it is about to reach always at once.
chinese: 玩家移动时，游戏已读取的区块中位于前进方向两侧该角度内的会优先并入（由近及远）；即将到达的区块总是立即并入。

english: While the view is on: opens the inventory screen with the cursor free, or closes it, as the game's own inventory key does.
chinese: 视角开启时:打开背包界面并释放光标，或关闭它，等同游戏自带背包键。

english: While you aim a cast, a ring on the water shows where it will land, as wide as the game's scatter at your Fishing skill; while the cast flies, a small one marks the spot it lands on.
chinese: 抛竿瞄准时，水面上的环显示落点范围，大小对应你的钓鱼技能；抛竿飞行时用小环标出落点。

english: While you eat, drink, take a pill, bandage or treat a wound, read or put on make-up, the screen closes so you watch it, and comes back as it was when you are done. Opened again meanwhile, it stays. Off: the screen stays.
chinese: 吃喝、服药、包扎/治疗、阅读或化妆时界面自动关闭以便观看动作，完成后恢复原样；期间再次打开则保持打开。关闭:界面不关闭。

english: While you hold a firearm, the ADS key does not open the vehicle / animal radial menu that shares it (V), and Viewpoint Interface's interaction prompt and action menu step aside while you aim. Lower the gun or holster it to use them.
chinese: 持枪时瞄准键不会触发与其共用的载具/动物径向菜单 (V)，且瞄准期间 Viewpoint Interface 的交互提示与动作菜单会让位。放下或收起枪即可使用。

english: While you place or move something in first or third person, marks the square it goes on, green where it can go and red where not (the game's highlight colours), with a strip along the edge for a wall, a door or a barricade. The see-through preview shows either way. In furniture mode, marks the squares of the object you aim at, green where you can do the action and red where not.
chinese: 第一/第三人称放置或移动物品时，标出目标格子:可放为绿、不可为红（沿用游戏高亮色），墙、门或路障沿边缘显示条带。半透明预览始终显示。家具模式下标出瞄准对象所占格子，可操作为绿、不可为红。

english: With the free camera on, draws the third-person camera's rig: the pivot, the shoulder, the camera wanted and the camera placed.
chinese: 开启自由相机时，绘制第三人称相机骨架:支点、肩位、目标相机与实际相机。

english: With the sights fully up, hold the Steady aim key (Left Shift by default, in the game's Options > Keybinds) to hold your breath: the sway almost stops for up to 5 seconds, then you breathe out with a short shake and have to let go of the key before you can steady again. Breath comes back in about 6 seconds. Magnified scopes are only steadied; iron sights, red dots and holo sights also zoom in a little. The eye and the gun do not move, so nothing clips.
chinese: 完全抬镜后按住稳定瞄准键（默认左 Shift，见游戏「选项 > 按键」）屏息:晃动几乎停止，最长 5 秒，随后呼气伴随短促抖动，需松开按键才能再次稳定。气息约 6 秒恢复。倍镜只获得稳定；机瞄、红点与全息还会略微放大。眼位与枪身不移动，因此不会穿模。

english: With Viewpoint UI off, in first and third person: the inventory key and Tab open the game's own inventory and loot windows and free the cursor for them. Off: Viewpoint leaves the inventory key to the game and to other mods, for a mod with an inventory of its own, and Tab opens nothing. The Cursor free or locked key then frees the cursor for what opens.
chinese: Viewpoint 界面关闭时，第一/第三人称下:背包键与 Tab 会打开游戏自带的背包与战利品窗口并释放光标。若此项也关闭:Viewpoint 把背包键让给游戏与其它模组（供自带背包的模组使用），Tab 不打开任何东西，此时用「光标释放/锁定」键为打开的界面释放光标。

english: Within how far a drop is drawn towards a bigger one beside it (their radii together).
chinese: 水滴被拉向旁边更大水滴的距离（以两者半径之和计）。

english: Writes each frame drawn and each step of the game's for half a minute into the user folder's viewpoint-frame-traces, then turns itself off.
chinese: 把半分钟内绘制的每一帧与游戏的每一个步长写入用户目录的 viewpoint-frame-traces，随后自动关闭。

english: Your column lists only the container chosen with the icons at its top right (your inventory, a bag, a key ring), as the game's inventory window shows the one chosen. Off: it lists every container you carry, the chosen one framed.
chinese: 你的列只列出右上角图标选中的容器（背包、袋子、钥匙环），与游戏背包窗口一致。关闭:列出你携带的所有容器，选中的加边框。

english: Your gun occupies real space: near walls, closed doors and windows, tall furniture and vehicles it slides back and rises into a compressed ready instead of passing through, and returns exactly to your sights when there is room again. Long rifles need more room than pistols. First and third person, hip and ADS. Visual and handling only (client side); shots still leave along your aim. Untick to switch the whole system off.
chinese: 枪械占据真实空间:靠近墙壁、关闭的门窗、高家具与载具时会后收并抬起成压缩持枪姿态而非穿模，空间足够时精确回到瞄准位置。长枪比手枪需要更多空间。第一/第三人称、腰射与开镜均适用。仅影响视觉与手感（客户端），子弹仍沿瞄准方向射出。取消勾选可整体关闭。

english: Zombies chasing the player farther than this are updated every other frame: they react a frame later there, and a big chase costs about half as much. 30 is the game's own reach.
chinese: 追击玩家距离超过该值的丧尸改为隔帧更新:其反应慢一帧，大规模追击开销约减半。30 为游戏自身范围。

english: Zombies' and corpses' clothes, blood, dirt and holes drawn by the model shader from the game's own textures, instead of the textures the game makes for each of them, which turning in a crowd waits on and which take video memory.
chinese: 丧尸与尸体的衣物、血迹、污渍与破洞由模型着色器直接使用游戏贴图绘制，而不用游戏为每具单独生成的贴图（人群中转身会等待、并占用显存）。
